135000.description:
Stubborn office worker Seiji Kondou's latest obsession is a new deli that's exactly up his alley. The only catch is that the suspiciously flirty owner, Haruki Kakibaya, keeps calling Seiji "cute". One day, Haruki kisses Seiji out of the blue...!! This is a delicious love story between a flirty cook and a bashful office worker.

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Contains an extra chapter.

title.english: How to Make a Delicious You
title.native: 美味しいキミの作り方

135001.description: One of Tsurita's two debut one shots, published in the September 1965 issue of Garo.

135002.description:
One-shot manga about Death Zero, a legendary fighter plane pilot, which also serves as inspiration for the "Shaman King: Flowers" character of the same name.

First compiled in volume 2 of "Butsu Zone," and later in volume 33 of the Kodansha edition of "Shaman King."

135003.description:
A young manga artist is visited by a friend who wants the artist to pay back the money he loaned him. The artist refuses, asking the friend to wait until his story sells. The friend is kicked out of the house and vows to come back later for his money.

Note: one of Tsurita's two debut one shots, published in the September 1965 issue of Garo.

135004.description:
Saya, a young girl in a wheelchair, dreams of playing baseball, her favorite game. At the medical center where she is hospitalized for treatment, she meets Akira, a high school baseball player, but she dies in a car accident on her way to observe Akira's practice. The Shinigami takes pity on Saya, who died so young, and gives her 49 days to live in exchange of his own life. Saya is brought back to life as a high school student and joins the Kikugawa West High School baseball team, aiming for the Koshien Championship with Akira and the others.

Note: The first release of this manga series contained 5 volumes in total, while the following ones had 3.

135005.description:
Chiori is envious of all the couples around her in high school. When she told her childhood friend Issei that she wanted to to be confessed to and have a boyfriend, too, he asked, "Why not go out with me?" The dream life as a boyfriend-girlfriend couple begins!

(Source: Manga Park, translated)

title.native: 理想の彼氏のはずなのに
title.romaji: Risou no Kareshi no Hazu nano ni

135006.description:
"This isn't what I thought a magical girl would be like..."
A new exciting magical girl comedy from Kosuzume-sensei, the creator of "Circle Crash!" and "Let's Talk About Love!!"

(Source: Ganma, translated)

title.native: 魔法少女はそうじゃない！

135007.description:
Makino failed her college entrance exam. Her only comfort is in her 2D game characters... until she found an ad for a call-girl who looked exactly like her favorite in-game waifu! The yuri love comedy between a gullible young woman and a street-wise call-girl begins now!

(Source: Ganma, translated)
synonyms: A Scummy Gap Student With a Hard Life Calls Upon a Lady of the Night

title.native: クズ浪人生、人生が辛いので夜のお姉さんを呼んでみた
title.romaji: Kuzu Rounin-sei, Jinsei ga Tsurai node Yoru no Onee-san wo Yonde Mita

135008.description: In a world, alongside humans, there exists a species that resembles them. They are known as 'cats'. In this world, humans carry the responsibilities of providing manual labor and sexual services. Cats experience periods known as 'heat cycles'. Unlike female cats, the male cats, who can enter countless heat periods utilize human males as their primary source of relief and medications to help suppress the influence of these heat periods. In a certain country, in a world known as this one…a cursed little black cat who lived in a big, big mansion picked up a strange man off the street.

135009.description:
Four Fiances!? Miyabi Asahina is from a super-rich family and on the day of her graduation she finds out she's engaged... to four completely different guys! One is blond and stuck up, another a hot-and-cold type, the third a long-haired sophisticated kind and the fourth are really pretty but cool. Miyabi has no idea of what to make of any of this, but before long she ends up living with them! Despite having dreamt of an average life after graduation, where she would work and earn her own income, Miyabi's everyday life turns out to be anything but average...Before long she walks in on one of them half-naked, and having no idea of how to react, things eventually escalate...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 朝比奈さんの婚約事情―4人だなんて聞いてないっ！
title.romaji: Asahina-san no Konyaku Jijou Yonin da Nante Kiitenai!

135010.description: A manga anthology based on the DMM Games/Nitroplus browser game Touken Ranbu -ONLINE- by the editorial department of seinen magazine Hibana.
synonyms: โทเคนรันบุ - บุรุษศาสตรา จงโปรยปรายบุปผาอัคคี

title.native: 刀剣乱舞－ONLINE－ アンソロジー ～ヒバナ舞え、刀剣男士～
title.romaji: Touken Ranbu Online Anthology: Hibana Mae, Touken Danshi

135011.description:
Still recovering from his past scars and navigating his attraction to the same sex, Unyul prefers to keep to himself—that is, while enjoying a low radar FWB relationship with his roommate and best friend. Then, comes along Seoha Han, a "god-given" perfection of a human being that is his exact ideal type. Opening himself up to love once more, Unyul must work to maintain his existing relationship with his roommate while trying to build himself a new one with his "lovely" Seoha. It's okay to pretend a little in front of the person you like, right? Will they still love me after knowing who I truly am? Who is this sweet, sweet swindler?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: Includes 33 extra chapters.

135012.description:
In a village encircled by strange rumors of a certain estate, Yoon "A," an average high school boy, is suddenly dumped with a single handwritten letter. As A retraces the clues his (ex)girlfriend left behind in order to discover the reasons behind her decision, he becomes closer to Shin "B," the slightly gloomy and strange student librarian...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
synonyms: The Portrait of A and B

135013.description:
Potts has always admired the beauty of human emotions... However the first human he speaks to has none.

(Source: Lalatoon)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 16 extras.

135014.description:
Starting Reiwa with a bang, a series of neo-sensual ghost stories begins!

(Source: Fakku!)

Published in WEEKLY Kairakuten Vol.1

title.english: Strange Sexual Tales of Past and Present - Chiinouya
title.native: 珍古今和姦集 乳の親

135015.description:
When your average guy struggling through life in modern day Korea gets “reborn” as a grand prince in the Joseon Dynasty, it seems like a pretty sweet deal, right? Nope, not if you’re the younger brother of King Yeon-San, one of the most tyrannical kings in Joseon’s history. A reign of terror is imminent, and it’s only a matter of time before everything goes downhill. But with a new Grand Prince Jin-Seong taking matters into his own two hands, perhaps history won’t repeat itself…

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: I Shall Live as a Prince

135016.description:
My bias has an NSFW account?!

Woo-Seok is a solo idol of three years who has been a big fan of an actor named Se-Ju. After having the chance to work on the same drama, Wooseok accidentally uncovers a secret of Se-Ju... By chance, Woo-Seok discovers an NSFW account with the same body as Se-Ju!

Doubtful, Woo-Seok reaches out to Se-Ju, who confidently replies that it really was him on that account.

To make his bias stop using the account, Woo-Seok promises to do anything Se-Ju wants but..

(Source: PeanuToon, translated)

135017.description:
Let’s say that you’re an average college student living with your friend, who is totally handsome, very smart, and treats you well. He’s the ideal roommate. Now, let’s say that you accidentally find out that this friend is into BDSM, and then he propositions you for sex. Sounds wild, right? Well, that’s the exact situation Sodam lands in when his friend Hajoon turns out to be very into BDSM. But Sodam isn’t into that kind of stuff. His tastes run fairly vanilla…or do they?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

135018.description:
Everything he touches breaks!

Naru has always believed he was cursed — whatever he touches breaks. But when a glass-shattering incident leads to a twisted encounter with a man who has supernatural powers, Naru begins to realize there's a world beyond his own where unimaginable powers exist...

(Source: Manta)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 8 extras.

135019.description: The one who traumatized me in my youth! He’s back. Even worse, he’s now a charming man charging in with overflowing affection. The irresistible yet forbidden tug of war (of love?) begins now!

135020.description:
Here to whisk away... one of Santa's helpers ♥

(Source: Fakku!)

Published in COMIC Shitsurakuten 2019-01.

135021.description:
A competent but inferiority complex-ridden Recessive Alpha, Jihyung's ultimate objective is to become a professor. But when Eunsung, the new, youngest professor at school, becomes his advising professor, his plans go awry. Feeling great jealousy toward Eunsung, an Omega disguised as an Alpha, he decides to use him instead to achieve his goals.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

135022.description:
An overflowing (with boobs) waitress girl. ❤

(Source: Fakku!)

Published in Comic Shitsurakuten 2019-10.

135023.description: Kirika is suffering from heavy periods. A tall member of the volleyball team, Mito, tells her that she used to long for her...?

135024.description: Shima Sakon was a brave and honorable samurai, and grandfather of Yagyuu Yoshikane (Yagyuu Renyasai). He was a capable subordinate of Ishida Mitsunari, and fought against Tokugawa Ieyasu in the battle of Sekigahara. Some history books tell us Sakon had died in that battle. Others say he survived and escaped to Kyoto with the Yagyuu family. And others...?
synonyms: Sakon - Record of the Upheaval of the Warring States

135026.description:
A boy who has lost his parents and is on the verge of starving to death is rescued by a woman. The woman saves his life and the boy looks up to her as his master, but his wish is to be cut down by her so he can die beautifully…?

Note:
- May 2018 semi-finalist candidate winner in the RISE Newcomer Manga Award.
- Originally published in Jump SQ.RISE 2018 Autumn issue.

135029.description:
There used to be many werewolves, but now only few remain.. here is detailed the tragic fate of werewolf twins Skoll and Hati in this, the final testament to the moon.

“I want to hurry and grow up…”

The first volume of Sayaka Mogi’s ongoing series, this book introduces the werewolf twins who play an integral role in the story of the wolfkin tribe. This work both stands alone as an independent story and functions as a continuation of the Kodansha digital series Red Riding Hood’s Wolf Apprentice and the overarching world of Humans, Beastkin, and Hunters. Sayaka Mogi continually refines their line with the spinning of this new epic yarn of fantasy / adventure / drama.

This is an independent story to the original Kodansha Red Riding Hood’s Wolf Apprentice series, and no prior knowledge is required.

(Source: Glacier Bay Books)
synonyms: RED RIDING HOOD'S WOLF APPRENTICE-Testament to the Moon-

title.native: 赤ずきんの狼弟子-月への遺言-
title.romaji: Akazukin no Ookami Deshi: Tsuki e no Yuigon

135030.description:
Together under one roof… ❤ The stimulation is too much!

(Souce: Fakku!)

Published in Weekly Kairakuten 2019-09, 2019-11 & 2020-01.

135031.description:
After learning that her fiancé cheated on her, Ally decides to ditch him and take their honeymoon by herself. Once there, she meets a shockingly handsome man named Chris and spends a passionate few days with him. With the knowledge that this attractive man will never be more than a vacation fling, Ally returns to England. But soon she discovers she’s pregnant! After deciding to raise the baby by herself, she is shocked when Chris suddenly appears!

(Source: Harlequin)

135032.description: A series following a knight in service to the Duke of Somerset, one of the supporters of the House of Lancaster in the Wars of the Roses, a conflict in 15th-century England between the supporters of two rival houses with crests of red and white roses. What is this knight thinking, as he faces the encroaching enemy...?!

135033.description: Goumoto's new story in magazine Aokishi.

135034.description:
On a winter morning, at a resort, three people are casually dressed on their way out the door. The story captures the lovable moments of their daily lives.

(Source: Aokishi, translated).

135035.description:
Four years ago, Kate lost her beloved brother, her only remaining family. To exacts her revenge on Aidan, the man who drove her brother to his death, she attends his wedding and messes up the ceremony by claiming to be his wife. But Kate was mistaken-the man she truly wanted revenge upon was Aidan's twin brother!

(Source: Harlequin)

135036.description: Ryou Yasohachi's new one shot in magazine Aokishi vol. 2a.

title.native: ムジナは赤子にかなわない

135037.description:
This is a manga about a high school girl and a cat god who makes a lot sporadic meta-commentary in the middle of the story.

(Source: Aokishi, translated)

title.native: 女子高生としゃべる猫神さま(仮)

135038.description:
Set in Taiwan at the end of the 19th century, this is a historical fantasy about its aboriginal people, living proudly with nature.

(Source: Aokishi, translated)

135039.description:
The love between Theodore and Sonya, born from two different breweries in the same town, gets caught up in their rivalry.......

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: The crown story from goat and sheep

title.native: ヤギと羊の王冠 (クローネ)

135041.description: Mirai Hasegawa's new one shot in magazine Aokishi vol. 2b

title.native: ホールド・ミー・タイト

135043.description: Ichika Ootsuki's new one shot in magazine Aokishi vol. 2b.

135044.description: Kouko Nagano's new series in magazine Aokishi.

135045.description:
A half year after returning to Sydney, Sophie just can't seem to get a job interview. Annoyed, she enters a hair competition, where she gets an offer for an interview from a law firm because of her flaming red hair. As unconventional as it is to get an interview this way, Sophie is ecstatic about the chance and Jason, the dashing young lawyer she'll be working with.

(Source: Harlequin)

135046.description: Makegumi Jinsei's new one shot in magazine Aokishi vol. 2b.

title.native: 魔法戦士ウィザードール

135047.description:
Giles Channing may hail from England, but he's quickly become a top developer at Orion Developers International. Teddy Beaumont is out to redevelop a city block in Atlanta, and he's hired Giles to handle the development...unless Kate Beaumont has her way. Who will win out? The English business developer or the local girl on a mission?

(Source: Harlequin)

135048.description:
Cairo Kingswood's father has left behind a mountain of debts, so the once-spoiled Cairo has to find work. She can make a lot of money if she's willing to scout the desert for a photo-shoot location. While looking for a guide, she's introduced to Max Falconer who immediately shows his dislike of her. Not willing to give up, Cairo goes ahead and intrudes on one of his trips through the desert. Cairo gets into trouble at every turn, and Max keeps finding himself having to take care of her. For her part, Cairo finds Max's attitude toward her annoying, but she can't help but be attracted to him. Their fiery disputes turn into fiery acts of passion one night in an oasis. Was it the influence of the desert oasis that finally sparked their desire for one another? If so, their dalliance will naturally end once Cairo's work in the desert is finished. Will Max allow it to end there?

(Source: Harlequin)

135049.description:
Yurioka Yamato has been looking forward to her first day of high school. On her way there, while trying to help someone, she gets into trouble, but she's saved by a handsome blonde boy.

His name is Kamirozuka Jin, scion of the largest Yakuza gang in the area.

She's told to stay away from him, but seeing him rescue a cat by the riverside and standing all alone in the rain, she can't help but feel curious about him.

Then one day, her mother told her a shocking revelation:

"Your father... died because of that boy."

Is that true? Did he kill my father? In order to find out the truth, Yamato decides that she needs to get to know Jin better.

A son of the yakuza and the daughter of a policeman. Two people who should never have crossed paths. Their love affair hangs on the truth that lies between them!

(Source: Manga Mee, translated)

135050.description:
Awkward high school student Koharu Minami is in love with Shimizu, the popular boy in her class. So she's shocked when she inadvertently discovers that his friendly demeanor is all an act. Or is it? The more time they spend time together, the more Koharu notices the kindness hidden behind the constant teasing and disgruntled comments. Could finding out about "the real Shimizu" actually end up bringing the two closer together?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: 外面男子と不器用女子が良い感じになりそうでならない話。
Sotozura Danshi to Bukiyo Joshi GA II Kanji NI Narisou de Naranai Hanashi

title.english: Shimizu Is Just a Tad Two-Faced

135051.description:
Crystal works at a boutique and must attend her company's Christmas party. She says yes when a charming man at the party asks her for a dance, but when the lights go out for a moment at the end of the song, he disappears. She later realizes that the man she was dancing with was the president of her company. And just two weeks later she finds herself butting heads with her dance partner!

(Source: Harlequin)

135055.description:
I'm going to become a K-pop idol! Neo, who was hospitalized with a leg injury, was watching TV out of boredom when a dance scene from a K-pop group caught her eye. She was instantly captivated, completely mesmerized. 'No matter what, I'm going to stand on that stage!' And so begins the story of a young girl chasing her dreams.

(Source: Ciao, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 7 extra chapters.

title.native: そしてミヤはいなくなった

135063.description:
The people of Mars (Hiboshi) live in 108 domes that recreate their world heritage. The history of Amatsuboshi, or Earth, the planet of their ancestors, has become a myth, and the people of Mars only recognize the world as the dome itself, forgetting that they are even living on Mars.

The Kuniazuma Dome, where the story takes place, is a land based on Taisho era Japan. Hime, the girl who protects it, fulfills her role as a priestess at the Usano Shrine and leads a peaceful life at the shrine with her friend Aki and Imi, the daughters of a wealthy merchant.

One day, however, a young man from the imperial capital changes Hime's fate. In order to find out her mission and who she is, Hime and her friends follow the young man on a pilgrimage as shrine maidens.

(Source: Wikipedia Japan, translated)

135064.description:
1. マダム・ハルコ (1) 悪徳の不幸 (Madame Haruko 1: Akutoku no Fukou)
2. マダム・ハルコ (2) 美徳の栄え (Madame Haruko 2: Bitoku no hae)
3. マダム・ハルコ (3) 宇宙人国旅行記 (Madame Haruko 3: Uchuubito-koku Ryokou-ki)

Note: originally published in 1968. A revised version was published in 1970.

135066.description: A strange little slice-of-life story about a group of five men living in the city during the 60s. One is a part-timer at an office, two work in a road crew, a fourth seems to be a university student and the fifth just shows up at a coffee shop at the end.

135067.description: A fickle woman turns down a man because he’s too short and she prefers taller men, so the man becomes a scientist and develops a pill that makes people grow taller. He succeeds and the pills then go on the market.

135068.description:
Everyone has their own little secrets. My secret is about a special someone, who isn't like anyone else.

(Source: Toomics)

135069.description:
He was hit by a bolt of lightning and time-traveled back to thousands of years ago. What he didn’t expect was, someone had already waited for him for decades... His arrival brought big changes to so many people’s fates. That young boy who had been waiting for him for years also got the chance to meet him, know him, and fall in love with him. However, hiding behind their romance is the redemption of the older generation...

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: The Beauty of the Apricot Forest
The Beauty in the Apricot Forest

135070.description:
When Yosai was in the second grade, she was in a car accident, but thanks to a mysterious "hero", her life was saved.
One day, Yosai was about to get trapped in an elevator when an older boy suddenly appeared to tell her that she is in danger.
That boy is the same person who saved Yosai from the accident!
He has the mysterious power to "see danger in color" like a signal...?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

135071.description:
Those fingertips, that tongue... They're not enough anymore...!

Yuri is dating the upperclassmen of her dreams and life has never been better! Or it should be, but she has a secret... She can't get turned on by his touch in bed. So, Yuri goes to get help from a specialist, but that doctor...!! To make matters even worse, she climaxes!! But, she's in love with her boyfriend... Yet, she can't get that doctor out of her head! Dr. Narumi and Yuri's secret sessions are underway...!
synonyms: 白袍野獸～醫生的手指讓我好有感覺～

title.native: 白衣のケダモノ～先生の指で感じちゃう～
title.romaji: Hakui no Kedamono: Sensei no Yubi de Kanjichau

135072.description: What should I do? He told me "I’m 15 years old and a freshman" even though I’m in college… and I kissed a boy who is still in 9th grade!

title.english: The Boy Is Too Young. Is This a Crime?
title.native: 年下すぎる男子。これって犯罪？

135074.description:
This is a mysterious romance between horror novelist Seol Gong-Chan and his downstairs' neighbor.

Ghosts aren't real... right? Gong-Chan has a wild imagination as a horror-novel author with a knack for turning his mundane life into a harrowing ghost story. These spooks live only in his head... that is until he meets Young-Min, a man haunted by the supernatural specters in Gong-Chan’s novel! With everything around him suddenly turning into an eerie mess, is Gong-Chan's growing love for Young-Min the reason why his heart is racing? Or is it the bloody ghost behind him?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes nine extra chapters.
synonyms: บังเอิญรักคุณนักเขียน
隣人には幽霊が見えるようです

title.english: The Spooky Love Tale of Gongchan Seol

135076.description: In a boarding school where talented young boys are gathered together, Tatsumi has the best grades and is the "president's favorite." However, his place was just stolen by the pretty boy Azuma who's rumored to be getting the president's attention. Tatsumi is irritated by this, but is forced to yield to Azuma whose personality completely changed from the harassment he's been receiving. Ever since then, Tatsumi's been scared of Azuma. Tatsumi ends up in the same room as him but slowly realize where his fear comes from...

135078.description: Ai is a 20-year-old bikini model who likes to use a strap-on on her 24-year-old boyfriend, Yuuichi, who is also a model. She is a strong girl who has overcome her sexual frustration. On the other hand, Yuuichi loves Ai no matter what and has accepted being the receiver. He has played with a lot of girl in his past relationships until he met Ai-chan.

title.romaji: Ai no Katachi: Peniban Joshi to Mesu Danshi

135079.description:
Unhappy with his life, 29-year-old Kunimi decides to jump in front of a moving train. But, when he wakes up, he realizes he has gone back to being a high schooler! With a lapse in his memories, Kunimi meets a super handsome junior named Gaku. While disappointed that even in this after-life, Kunimi is gay, he gets excited at the prospect of his almost 30-year-old self doing it with a high schooler. When Kunimi finds out Gaku has real feelings for him, he feels bad about having a wet dream about Gaku.

As his memories slowly start to come back to him, 29-year-old Kunimi gets a chance to re-do his high school experience with a genuine and super hot high schooler!

(Source: Renta!)

synonyms: The God Who Can't Clean Up

135083.description:
Haruka Sakura wants nothing to do with weaklings—he's only interested in the strongest of the strong. He's from Fuurin High School, a school of near-dropout degenerates known only for their brawling strength. And in a town known for its territorial disputes, Haruka's got only one goal—become the hero his town deserves.

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: วินด์เบรกเกอร์

135085.description: "We may be like this, but if we don't give up, we will surely reach the dream stage, Koshien!" Jyosei Private Academy. After it changed its policy and became a cut-throat academic elite school, its once powerful baseball team has become weak with only four members left. However, baseball maniac Ruito Hibino has a secret plan! Aiming for Koshien is an amateur tag-team of misfits? Straight from the bottom of hell.

135086.description:
The beautiful and talented Yukina-senpai is always being mean and demeaning towards her neighbor Keita-kun when they're together. But Keita can hear Yukina talking to herself through the wall when she's alone. "I got to spend so much time with my favorite Keita-kun today! I will confess to him tomorrow, for sure!" A love comedy about a girl with a poisonous tongue leaking her true feelings!

(Source: Hobby Japan, translated)

title.native: 毒舌少女はあまのじゃく ~壁越しなら素直に好きって言えるもん!
title.romaji: Dokuzetsu Shoujo wa Amanojaku: Kabegoshi nara Sunao ni Suki tte Ierumon!

135087.description:
An omega opening a detective bureau, Idou Jitsuya, has a pair. Kitakouji Kazuhiro, Jitsuya’s alpha, is an elite detective from the Metropolitan Police Department. Together they’re business partners who made a mutual agreement to become a pair. Jitsuya uses this pair to control his omega constitution. As an “S”, Kitakouji uses Jitsuya for insider information. Even though it was meant to be a cut and dry relationship, an omega’s body needs to have sex regularly his pair…

Involuntarily, Kitakouji and his omega’s body are forced against their will. The most vexing for both of them, the sex with their pair is the best they’ve ever had. While continuing this distorted relationship, an illegal drug case aiming at omegas is at large!? Raising the curtain on a BL where two men become a pair to mutually use each other!

Note: Chapter count includes one extra.

title.native: ダブルフェイク -Double Fake- つがい契約

135088.description:
The main character, a coffee shop owner, is in love with Yusuke, a student and a regular at the shop. However, it is an unrequited love. Yusuke seems to be interested in him too, but the shy shop owner has no intention of confessing, saying, "Just looking at him is enough." But when Sakurai, a regular customer who has known the owner for a long time, started to tell him how he feels, things take a turn for the worse... A sad and fragile love-triangle story!

(Source: Takadashobo, translated)

135089.description:
"Suddenly, a kiss with someone you admire!?"

Nakamura Oto, a model who gets nervous even shooting promotional pictures is thinking about quitting his job. That's when Shion, a cameraman, tells him that an acquaintance of his is looking for a model. Unable to refuse, he decides to meet with the client... but when arrives at the meeting place, Ryou, a makeup artist he admires is there?! Moreover, he's kissed by a half-asleep Ryou!?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: メイクイットオンリーラブ

135090.description:
Mi-Nu is a shy college student who becomes entangled in a whirlwind relationship with notorious bad guy Yu-Jin. Mi-Nu believes in true love, but Yujin only believes in one-night stands. Yu-Jin reveals his deepest secret to Mi-Nu in order to seduce him, but things take an unexpected twist when Yu-Jin develops feelings for Mi-Nu. Will Mi-Nu and Yujin be able to overcome their differences and find true love?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

135092.description: Su-in, who couldn't protect his friend and wife, took Tae-hyun, who was left alone, as an adopted son. Two people in the family who have nothing but each other, their love for each other is deepening... Is the end of an unauthorized relationship doomed?

135093.description:
To the outside world, Ji-Hun and Seon-Jae seem like ordinary classmates, but there is something unspoken binding them that no one else can see. Ji-Hun follows Seon-Jae’s every word without question, as if under some quiet, unbreakable command. Watching from the sidelines is Ki-Wung, who grows increasingly disturbed by the dynamic and tries to pull Ji-Hun out of Seon-Jae’s shadow. As the line between control and devotion begins to blur, Ji-Hun must decide whether he can truly break free from Seon-Jae’s grip or if he has already surrendered to it completely.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 12 side story chapters.

135094.description:
Wen’s boyfriend, Hua, seemed perfect. He’s super hot, a little oblivious, and—as Wen will soon find out—was an adult film star in gay porn?! He says he did it for the money but, when more secrets and more lovers appear from the past, Wen can’t decide who Hua really is. Does he love her? Or is this just one of his many faces…

(Source: Tapas)

135095.description:
This story begins like any other, with a tragic death and reawakening in a new world. Kang Yerin, after being hit by a truck, wakes up as Ashley Lute, the 2nd daughter of a noble household. Without the burden of being the firstborn or the need to earn a living, “Ashley” expected to live worry-free. But, what should’ve been a cushy life in high society, soon turns into one life-threatening hassle after another. Pulled in every direction, she is forced to go on a quest to defeat the Demon King, forced to keep her heroic quest a secret, and forced to re-enroll at the academy she left behind years ago, making her a downright “fossil” compared to her peers. Trapped under her murderous older sister’s thumb and stuck between a sibling rivalry over the crown, Ashley can never seem to catch a break. In a twisted irony, how hard will Ashley Lute have to work to be able to live the easy life she’s always wanted?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

135096.description:
He bought me for 50 sacks of rice.

Soongap is nearly beaten to death by his master when friendly giant Bongchun buys him and saves his life. Bongchun's blind mother is delighted, believing her son has finally brought home a bride. And the more Bongchun treats Soongap like his darling bride, the more things get heated...

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes 18 extra chapters.

135097.description:
Heo Doh is the first prince in line for the crown, but everybody seems to favor his younger brother over him. Even his newly promoted eunuch, Hae-Min, sneaks off to spend time with the younger prince. When Heo Doh walks past Hae-Min’s quarters early one morning, he happens to witness the eunuch doing something thought to be impossible: masturbating while moaning the younger prince’s name. The possessive and jealous Heo Doh questions Hae-Min, but he denies that event ever took place. So, Heo Doh makes it his mission to prove that Hae-Min isn’t impotent after all...

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: ความลับของขันที

135098.description:
The only pearl in the world that could turn Fox Fang into a human was accidentally swallowed by one of his classmates! In order to become human, the fox has to go great lengths to "provoke a man into bed". But who would have thought that he'd fall into the other man's trap?!

(Source: Pocket Comics)
synonyms: ขอสักครั้งมันยากนักเหรอ?

135100.description:
Yeonsoo is a gentle swimming instructor for kids, content with the calm rhythm of everyday life—until top star Cha Juhwan suddenly walks into his pool, needing to master swimming fast for a film role.

What starts as a professional arrangement quickly turns personal. Yeonsoo, shaped by years of gaslighting from a toxic partner, has come to believe he can only enjoy relationships that hurt. But Juhwan sees right through him, and offers something different—something kind.

"I’m used to getting hurt. My partner likes it that way."
"Then try it with me as well."
"I’m not talking about pain. I mean something real—something gentle."

With Juhwan’s quiet patience and unwavering honesty, Yeonsoo begins to realize that love doesn’t have to come with bruises. And maybe, just maybe, he deserves something softer.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes ten extra chapters.
synonyms: フリップターン〜ここからが僕の人生の折り返しだ〜

135101.description:
L was a werewolf cursed to be unable to stay in one place for a long time. One day, he lost an arm for some unknown reason, so he paid a visit to Sol, a dark sorcerer whom he heard would be able to heal him...

(Source: BomToon, translated)

135103.description:
Cute guy, Cha-Young! Cool guy, Kwon-Yul! And... some other dangerous ones?!

Cha-Young, who can see his dead mother's spirit, and Kwon-Yul, who can see ghosts but lies about it. One day, a dangerous (?) shaman appeared in front of them! Finding out that Cha-Young turns out to be surprisingly easily possessed by ghosts, the shaman decides to use him...!!

(Source: Kakao)

135104.description:
Han Taejoon, popular for his tall stature and good looks, is also a notorious troublemaker at school. While skipping group activities on a school trip, he crosses paths with a beautiful girl named Jisook and instantly falls in love. Despite his best efforts, Taejoon fails to find her again. As the new school year begins and his thoughts still consumed by the brief encounter, fate takes an unexpected turn when Taejoon finds himself in the same class as Kim Jiwoon. Jiwoon bears an uncanny resemblance to Jisook and even smells just like her. Could he be Jisook's brother...or maybe a cousin? It appears that there is more to this new classmate than meets the eye.

(Source: Lezhin US)

135105.description:
She just wants an average, normal boyfriend, that's all. Is that really too much to ask? 27-year-old Ah-Jin Seo has rotten luck with men-five jerks in a row?! I must be cursed! One breakup and a little drunken mishap later, Ah-Jin somehow finds herself at the actor Yu-Jun Nam's place. But wait... do I know you from somewhere?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

135106.description:
Eidar is a slave whose life has been rough and harsh in the cold northern provinces. However, Eidar decides to travel to the warm southern provinces as per his mother's wish, even though he doesn't have enough money to board the ship. Then he sees a recruitment flier for a male prostitute, which would allow him to board the ship for free. Although he has never worked as a prostitute, he decides that he'll do whatever it takes to get to the south.

Claude Whale struggles to find the elusive fourth map of Pfeos that will help him clear his family name. Since failed to locate the map in the north, he decides to leave. Then he meets Eidar on his ship. Claude hates Eidar the moment he lays eyes on him, because he resembles Julian, his former love who betrayed him. However, he can't resist the pull he feels toward Eidar.

Will Eidar be able to reach the south in one piece after his voyage with a bunch of horny sailors and a grumpy captain? Will Claude Whale be able to find the fourth map that will help him clear his family name? How will the relationship between the captain and Eidar unfold?

(Source: POCKET COMICS, edited)

135107.description: A manga anthology based on the DMM Games/Nitroplus browser game Touken Ranbu -ONLINE- by the editorial department of shoujo magazine B's-LOG.

title.native: 刀剣乱舞-ONLINE-アンソロジー ～出陣～

135109.description:
Following her reincarnation into the body of a storybook princess, little Asya only wants one thing: to bake lots of sweet and delectable desserts! Of course, her family is the poorest of the poor, but she’s willing to do whatever it takes to protect her dream and live a peaceful life surrounded by cookies. Unfortunately for her, Asya realizes that she is actually the malevolent Princess Anastasia, a girl who was blessed by a great and powerful spirit, whose hubris brings about her own miserable destruction. But where there’s a will, there’s a way, and Asya isn’t above using her childish charms and excellent baking skills to secure her safety! Plus, what could possibly go wrong when she has the mighty Spirit of Sensation at her side?

(Source: Tappytoon)

135114.description:
Tsumoi was taken care of by a shrine during his parent's long-term business trip, but in that shrine, there is a cute child – a shrine maiden named Toki-chan – of the same age.

A romantic comedy with a little H inside a sacred shrine!

135115.description: Atlantis. A land set towards destruction. Three people - the beautiful androgynous sorcerer Tieh, the young Lakshi and the reserved warrior Bois - wander this continent as it collapses around them. This is the tale of their adventures.

135116.description: Deto and delinquent Zono are merely opponents. But then Deto discovered Zono's weakness. If his neck is touched, Zono will let out erotic sounds. Hearing Zono's erotic moans, Deto's lower-body reacted and left him confused. One day, Deto ran into Zono, who was beaten into a pulp by his father, despite being very strong in fighting. Deto rushed in to rescue Zono. And why was Zono wearing fancy, cute-looking clothes?

135121.description:
A woman and her son are barely surviving on the street. She is waiting for her husband to come back from World War II, and is slowly befriended by a dwarf. She resists his aid and friendship at first, but with nothing else for her and her son, begins accepting his help. She worries that he expects a relationship in return, and throughout the story, it is variously implied that they are taking advantage of each other. But it takes a strange turn...

(Source: cbr)

Note: Manga was published in May, June, November, December issues of Garo 1993 and January issue of Garo 1994

Richard asks the street painter Pascal for a portrait on the spot. As soon as he sat down on a chair and took off his hat, Pascal ran away. The word he uttered while being caught was 'Richard'. Richard invites Pascal to his house, and the story of Pascal moving back and forth between the past and the present in a mansion full of beautiful art begins...

(Source: Lalatoon)

Just like described by the ancient poem, no pressure or disputes would arise in there, and the whole place seems like from a fairytale. Everything is perfect, but a feeling that something is wrong still remains. What is hidden behind the Peach Blossom Springs?

Telling the later life of Vagabond's Musashi Miyamoto, it was depicted through 140 hand-drawn drawings with ink and brush. It was released at the Ueno Royal Museum in Tokyo in May 2008, and since then it has been displayed at three other venues, Kumamoto City Museum, Suntory Museum in Osaka, and Sendai Mediatheque, with new paintings and productions.

Note: The comic was compiled in two books: "Inoueno: Mikazuki-hen" (いのうえの 三日月篇) and "Inoueno: Mangetsu-hen" (いのうえの 満月篇).

135131.description: Legend has it that an invasion of foreign enemies during the last years of Daqi disrupted the people's peaceful life. Aspiring men rushed to join the army to protect the country. The tall and handsome Liu Yan was no exception. Meanwhile, noble-born Ye Qinxue joined the army in search of Liu Yan. When they meet again, Liu Yan is strangely affected by Ye Qinxue...
synonyms: As Lovely as the Peach Blossoms

135132.description: Claiming to be the gaming industry’s streamer “Rising Star” Xia Ri. Due to the decline in popularity, he played a popular Otome game recommended by his younger sister, but unexpectedly went into the game dimension. In order to return to the real world, he had to pass through all the obstacles.

135133.description:
The first ever(!?) authentic "Kodanshi" manga! A new story about a traditional performing art, by a master of historical romance and hilarious essay manga, with assistance from the legendary Hakusan Kanda VI.

The future of Senka and Sentaro, the older and younger apprentices of the endangered "profession" of kodanshi, is uncertain. However, with the support of their master and the people around them, they continue on their "gei no michi", the path of exploration to learn the fascinating art of kodan.......

What kind of art form is "kodan" these days? How is it different from rakugo? How is it performed? If you want to know all about it...... and more, you can find out here!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

135134.description:
"Sometimes, your future gets decided by just one moment."

The whole kingdom of Jesús fell into a state of shock after hearing the news of Queen Mary Trizia’s Suicide. While everyone praised Mary Trizia for being an excellent queen, her older twin brother, Rafael Evans, was most suspicious of her death.

"It can only be you. No one else can save me other than you."

These words and the image of his sister screaming those words while approaching him bare-footed remained in his head. Rafael ventures out in search after his relatives for the first time in his life, to attend Mary’s funeral. But in the place where they found Mary’s body, Rafael finds a note…

“Lift up your face.”

Wanting to find Mary's killer, Rafael disguises himself as the new queen consort, Anne-Mary La Shore, and meets the king ‘Ivry.’

That moment marked the start of an unprecedented fate. The unexpected end of his sister who wasn’t like her younger self, and who he believed would find happiness…

What was the ‘hell’ that his sister dropped into? And what will change after Rafael and Ivry meet?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

135135.description:
Unbeknownst to his classmates, Shin Eunchae was born with a golden spoon in his mouth. He eats only the finest foods, travels in the most extravagant fashion, and has access to things beyond his classmates’ wildest imagination. Kang Juwon, on the other hand, is a poor, aspiring actor with the determination to make it big. When Juwon saves Eunchae from dangerous situation with a sunbae, the two grow especially close. There’s only one problem- Juwon hates Chaebols! Eunchae’s elite background must remain a secret, but things get complicated when Eunchae wants to help Juwon achieve his dream to become an actor. How will Eunchae navigate this new, uncharted territory…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Kenji, a dull middle-aged salaryman, has just gotten married to his young, beautiful wife, Kaede.
Her flawless white skin is slightly flushed with embarrassment, with pleading look in her glistening eyes, inspiring beast-like lust…
An explicit look at a couple's happily erotic married life!!

(Source: Goraku Web, translated)

135165.description:
Do you like a sister who's way too naughty?

Aoi, a tutor, appears at the door of Yota, a high school student. In the absence of his parents, Yota is at the mercy of a naughty tutor, but will he be able to overcome his worries and study? In addition, Ms. Aoi looks just like the sexy actress Sumire Nanasato...

135166.description:
Matsuno household has six naughty and mischievous sons (who are sextuplets), led by the eldest Osomatsu. They were grade-schoolers back in the Showa period, but despite still living in the same old household, the street view, as well as the lifestyle of modern day society, have changed drastically.

(Source: Anime News Network)

135168.description:
One night, under a blood red moon glimmering with demonic beauty, a group of devilish creatures armed with axes and spears came riding into a quiet city on horseback. One by one, they loaded the villagers up into cages and carried them off without any explanation...

I barely managed to escape alive.

(Source: Star Fruit Books)

title.native: 恐怖!!ブタの町―悪魔が町にやって来る
title.romaji: Kyoufu!! Buta no Machi: Akuma ga Machi ni Yatte Kuru

135169.description:
Lian is an apprentice angel who attends a high school for angels built in Heaven. Despite continuously working hard to become an archangel, she is unable to make friends and quickly became hated amongst her class. To put it simply, she is a loner.

She has a natural enemy: the school idol who looks like a gal demon, Ruri. Although she is not academically competent, Ruri is beloved by everyone. One day, however, Lian suddenly decides to start teaching Ruri! Ruri told her "Let's start as friends," causing Lian to become confused as she previously hated her.

This is the beginning of a friendship between a blue gal and a loner, a friendship that has until now been nonexistent, with the two enjoying every day of their youth!!!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

135170.description:
The Demon King has defeated every warrior he has come across, but when a weak little adventurer girl appears before him, he meets his match.

(Source: Anime News Network)

Note: Includes 6 extra chapters.
synonyms: The Brave and the Demon King

135172.description: A high school girl, Kanami Miria, reincarnated as the seventh daughter of an aristocrat. Since she had lived a miserable life, she dreamed of living peacefully in her second life. However, she reincarnated in a super-poor aristocratic family in the countryside. In order to achieve her goal to leave the house and live a peaceful life, she practiced magic and secretly went to the Royal Girls Academy. But, thanks to her omnipotent magical power, her evaluation became ridiculous. The easygoing Miria decided to ignore all invitations and aim for a relaxing life with her omnipotent magical power.
synonyms: Reborn Girl Starting a New Life In Another World As a Seventh Daughter: I heard I can live easily in aristocratic society if I have omnipotent magical power, though!?

135173.description: The story centers around a bureaucrat named Tohru, whose alchemy skills go unappreciated in his line of work. When he is expelled to the demon lord's domain, his life takes a huge turn. With his ability to create powerful magic items, he turns the kingdom around, alongside the company of a beautiful maid.

135174.description: Thor Regus, a boy who lived in the empire, was banished to the territory of the Demon Lord by the hands of his father, the Duke. The reason was that he could only use [Alchemy] and didn’t have any combat skills. The empire was a military country, and those without combat skills were discriminated against. That is why the Empire decided to make him a hostage and sacrifice to the Demon Territory. This is a story about an exiled boy who transcends Empires and Heroes and transforms the Demon Territory into a civilised power.

135175.description:
Deacon is a former warrior who once enjoyed a life of fame and honor, that is to say, before he went completely bankrupt. While Deacon rummages around to look for work, he runs into Lagabi: his long-time wizard friend and his secret crush. Knowing Deacon's situation, Lagabi decides to hire Deacon to assist him in his research projects that involve "special" experiments. Deacon enthusiastically accepts the offer, but the next thing he knows, he's being toyed by some slimy demonic tentacles! Turns out that this research assistant job wasn't exactly what Deacon had expected it to be. Now Deacon finds himself trapped in a cycle of pleasure, and he's willing to let his secret desires loose...

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

135176.description:
A girl named An Kuze is fascinated by Shogi. Finding joy in fighting against the strongest players, she joins the Encouragement Association, where shogi geniuses gather to become professionals.
There, the strongest players of her generation are honing their skills and seeking the path to becoming professionals. An also has a special ability, she can remember everything she sees, but this ability has a weakness: she cannot forget even the negative emotions.
Will she be able to use her not-so-easy to use ability to become a professional?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Does this mean he’ll never be able to be intimate with the man of his dreams… EVER!?

Why do other people enjoy all the glory and wealth and become gods when they jump to another world, but he, Jiang Zhaogo, became a desperate fugitive? The "divine beast" that's suppose to be his life-saving companion turns out to be a bear who calls him a loser? This is the worst isekai story ever! Will he ever get the chance to go back home?

135182.description:
In order to kill the dictator, an assassin wore female clothing and snuck into the palace. He didn't expect to be caught immediately that night. But the dictator did not kill him. Instead, he asked to sleep with the assassin and treated him like a sleeping pill.
After staying in the palace for a while, the assassin discovered a deep conspiracy, and the dictator didn't seem that bad after all. Meanwhile, he even started to feel a little sympathetic...

Xiang Qihong, a college student who hasn't been going to class, was asked by his friend the professor to help take care of his nephew! All of a sudden, he's got a new neighbor and kouhai to worry about! So used to being alone, can Xiang Qihong get along with the inscrutable boy?

135184.description: In Si Ling's family, there is a saying that if you kiss your soulmate, you will be able to enter each other's dream. One day, Si Ling unexpectedly met the An family's young master, An Yunxiu, and accidentally gave him her first kiss. Who would have thought that Si Ling was the first girl who was able to touch An Yunxiu? It was a fate that was already set, and nobody can break it.

135185.description:
A world between the past and the future. An airship that can only be seen by people whose hearts are hurting. A bookstore that soars between the clouds. Immerse yourself in a gorgeously illustrated art and story collection set in a magical world that includes steampunk zodiac girls, steampunk tarot card illustrations, and more!

High schoolers Fumi and Kaichi have been friends for almost 10 years, even though Fumi is dazzling and Kaichi is just an ordinary otaku.

Can I kill a person as a police officer!? It's been three and a half years since I became a yakuza, and the infiltration never ends.

The main character, a professional manga artist (32 years old and a virgin), recruits an assistant on the Internet. But what he receives is an erotic selfie of an unknown girl...! Do you know the pain of a small penis? Well one young man has lived his entire adult life being mocked and belittled by women. Now he's had enough and signed a deal with a devil to get what he wants...No matter the cost.

Haruka Ichijou became the school's kingpin because of his princely good looks and wild aura. For some reason, something about Mario Sena from class 1-B - the only class not under his thumb - intrigues him. The two go to the roof to settle things man to man!! ...Until Haruka makes a very unexpected advance...! Also included is a story about a quiet tough guy and his younger childhood friend, as well as the story of a loyal underling and a cool beauty. This is an anthology about love so sweet it hurts between delinquents in an all-boys school!!

135206.description: Araki Susumu is a hardworking father of two who was rejected and distanced by his family. On his 50th birthday, he suddenly loses consciousness and is transported into the body of a baby in another world, now living with the new name "Tidus". Determined to live a new life without regrets, he vows to live a fulfilling, happy life with himself and his new family.

The hero, Tomoe Dango, a manly man, engages his family and friends in a slapstick drama of everyday life.

But if I am disloyal to you, how would my empire matter anymore?” From young and naive to mature and experienced with the ways of the world, observe how the cute crown prince grows up, secluded in the palace, to be an unparalleled ruler of the world!

135209.description:
"To revenge is one thing. To conquer the bossy president is another."

Tong Yue has witnessed her mother's death in childhood. The nightmare still hunts her over years. This time she comes back to the Tong's mansion and swear she will take what belonged to her back. However, Han Tianlin, the most wealthy man in Long City, appears in her life. Tong Yue considers it a great idea to make use of him. But smart as Han Tianlian, would he be played around? 135212.description: During their childhood, Yuri gives to her friend the nickname Hanao (meaning "Flower Guy") because he likes flowers and is always taking care of them. He revealed that his dream is to grow the most beautiful flower in the world and she promised to support him to make it come true, will she keep her promise?

135214.description:
One day, high school student Arisu suddenly faints and wakes up to find himself in the middle of an intense fight with his best friend Oodate! Confused and disoriented, Arisu is unexpectedly exhilarated by the newfound sensations of his body, which has "developed" according to Oodate's words: “We've done it many times.” To make things stranger, his sister has become his brother, a female idol is now a male idol, and his best friend has turned into his boyfriend. He has apparently been transported to a “world where only men exist.” To return to his original world, Arisu is told that he must “recreate the situation in which he transported,” leading him to repeatedly have sex with Oodate...?

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

135215.description: Mary Lou Brown is a 15-year-old girl. Her elder sister, Laura, is loved by a lot of boys and they make a fuss in Laura's room every day. One day, Mary Lou meets George in front of her house. He's been looking up at Laura's room. He invites Mary Lou to a party at his house. Mary Lou gets excited. Her mother tells Laura to accompany Mary Lou to the party. Mary Lou is worried that George will be attracted to Laura because Laura is very pretty.

135216.description:
Masaki is a high school Otaku who loves Manga and video games. One day, Masaki is confronted by a delinquent in the hall at school. Masaki thought it was a shakedown for money, but instead, it was a confession. “Hey, you should go out with me.”

135221.description: Konno is a rookie in the criminal division. He is partnered with Minori Toyoman, a glamorous and cute senior whom he adores! But she has a secret that she won't tell anyone... she's a detective who dresses up in extreme costumes to catch the attention of criminals and make arrests! This is the first time he's seen her in action!

135223.description:
Kotori Hatsuse is a high school teacher, an exemplary good one who always thinks of her students first. And her students also treat her like a friend. One day, Kotori gets tangled up with some hoodlums by accident, and is saved by a handsome young man. He is Soichiro Haibara, a former student of hers from four years ago, who beat up the hoodlums with his uncommon strength. After the unexpected reunion, they decide to go out for dinner. But then the thug and his friends show up again.

"I'll always protect you, Sensei..."

Kotori is surprised by Haibara's unexpected confession, but when he embraced her with his strong arms, she couldn't help but feel her heart pounding...

135226.description:
Mitchell Edward Warner III, the son of a senator, made a promise to two friends in college: when each of them marries, he has to give up his most precious possession. A decade later, Mitchell has become a reclusive farm boy, and he's become the focus of an article Tori Barnett is writing for her magazine. Why did he escape the political life destined for him? He doesn't know it yet, but this writer might make Mitchell give up more than just his privacy.

(Source: Harlequin)

135227.description:
The familiar scents of gunpowder and kitty litter... When hardened men with a soft spot for felines look for a haven, they come to Kitty and Me, a bar with a select clientele and one ironclad rule: When inside, do not dare harm the cats that call it home. Here, the hitman known as Undertaker finds himself in the unenviable situation of mourning the recent loss of his beloved pet, Cheriko...and discovering that his next target is a fellow cat lover. But the concrete jungle isn't always so courteous as to wait outside, and the bloody truth about Undertaker's latest job is knocking at the door.

(Source: Yen Press)

After losing her husband, Justin, to an accident, Nathalie Thompson struggles to raise her twin girls, Lily and Rose. As a diabetic, she can't eat the delicious cakes she makes, but when she takes them to a wedding, she is reunited with an old friend of Justin's. Maybe there's room for a little sweetness in Nathalie's life after all?

(Source: Harlequin)

The stage is Momokiba High, the worst school in the area, filled with delinquents. The beautiful and delicate JK is actually the toughest fighter in the school, while the big and fierce-looking DK is timid and afraid to fight, together in an opposites-attract comedy!

(Source: Sho-Comi, translated)

135234.description:
Sawa Sakuraba was finally going to give up her dream of singing and take a regular job. But then she met an actor named Itsuki on the night before she started working. And from that moment on...! New entertainment-industry love story by Izumi Miyazono!

A romantic comedy manga that centers on Mei, an ordinary office worker, who just wants to work normally, get married normally, and be happy normally. Until her brother, who is in charge of their family's Japanese sweets shop got sick, and he asks her to take over and be the president. Trouble starts coming one after another, especially when a sadistic secretary starts working for her.

(Source: Anime News Network)

Aika struggles to be proactive in her relationships. She ignores real-life romance entirely in favor of Kaneda, a character from her favorite game, who is also a serial killer. She longs to meet her beloved Kaneda... and that intense desire sparks a miracle! When Aika wakes from her sleep, she finds herself inside that same horror game...!?

My boyfriend is a dangerous ronin?! This is a pure love story that jumps across time!

Matsuri Shirai's fiancé cheated on her, and she couldn't dream of love anymore.

That was her situation when suddenly, a bearish man appeared in her bathroom at home. Matsuri slips and falls, losing consciousness. When she opens her eyes, a kimono-clad man and self-proclaimed Ronin who calls himself Shuujurou Suou is cradling her in his arms. He tells Matsuri things like: in her past life, her name was Suma and she was the daughter of a samurai family, and that she was someone who committed lovers' suicide with him.

Naturally, Matsuri was unable to believe such an absurd tale, and she gently tries to get him to leave. However, Suou points out that a scar on her pinky is proof that she has been reincarnated...?

(Source: Pixiv Comic, translated)

Ha-Hyeon is a dancer who's just graduated high school. At the desperate request of his producer uncle, he ends up participating in Survival ID, an idol audition program. The plan was to have him eliminated early on, so how is he making it through every stage?!

A nobleman's daughter is working as an adventurer!?
But then she died in the dungeon!
When she woke up, a new life awaited her!
Is she really the holy priestess now, or was it all a big mistake!?
Sophia's grand (?) adventure as the holy priestess begins now!

And I'm Taesoo Choi, one of the many interns seen as nothing more than tin can robots by some of the senior doctors. To escape this chaos, I went hiking, where I found the nearly lifeless body of the esteemed surgeon Dr. Kauffrene. Despite my efforts, it was too late to save him, but somehow I gained all his medical knowledge! Now my life is changing in ways I never expected, but is this a blessing... or a curse?

(Source: Tapas)

135404.description:
Some people would jump at the chance at a new life, but when Jeongyun wakes up after a terrible accident and finds that she has become Lecian Fucernien, a character of a cliche, romantic fantasy novel, it feels like she’s woken up inside a nightmare. Disappointed as she is, she quickly accepts her fate and decides to make the best of her new life. The good news is that Lecian's character has a happy ending, but the bad news is that she's supposed to die once to get it. Between foiling her abusive new father’s plans of committing treason, finding a way out of her engagement to the crown prince, and avoiding the strange duke who seems to be stalking her, Jeongyun has a very long to-do list. On the orders of Buddha, Monk Sanzang and her companions pilgramaged the Western regions in search of his teachings. Unlike Sun Wukong, Zhu Bajie, and Sha Wujing, who had hoped to become gods in recognition of their contribution rather than being tied down to the life of Buddhism, Sanzang had wanted to remain in the human world and enjoy a new life as an ordinary human.

But as she was being dragged to Heaven by orders from the Buddha, she notices a strange tunnel leading to the human world in which she escapes into...

And the place where she fell is the Republic of Korea's Jeju Island! And she meets a guy named Lee Hyun?!

The time-slipped Monk Sanzang a.k.a Hyeon-Jeong and the tsundere Lee Hyun's turbulent romance!

But one day, in the lead-up to Inaba's birthday, Mizushima's jealousy gets the better of him. He hurts Inaba and finally makes him cry...! Filled with all your favorite characters, this sixth installment of the "Voice" series contains the story of how the "Standoffish Voice" boys met, and a bonus chapter about the "Worship My Voice" couple. See how the four couples express their love in the previously unpublished stories.

(Source: Renta!)

135453.description: Horror Manga by Masae Hashimoto and published in Akita Shoten in 1993.

title.native: デス・チェイサー ―死神を追え!

135454.description:
Why did he ever have to fall in love with a guy like Taichiro!? Mr. Super-Aggressive continues to be shaken up by his super airhead pal from childhood.

Handsome Tetsuji Aoi, fawned on by all the ladies, is the charismatic owner of an illegal casino. His only weakness is Taichiro, a guy he grew up with. He doesn't mind it, though, because his bright, cheerful, and unpredictable friend is the love of his life.
One day, Taichiro comes to Tetsuji and suddenly declares that he'll be his mistress!
Tetsuji starts touching innocent Taichiro's body hoping to scare him off, but the person he has forever had a crush on begins to get irresistibly aroused, and he doesn't know if he'll be able to keep his cool...

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Starting a Misteress Contract with a Childhood Buddy
title.native: 幼なじみと始める愛人契約

135455.description:
Childhood friends Naoki and Tamao are practically inseperable, but sleeping together before even exchanging an "I love you"...? That's not right! And now Tamao is doing whatever Naoki tells him to...?! Along with the popular series, "Bully Problems," comes a bonus chapter brimming with burgeoning adolescent lust at its finest!

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: 表題作 イジめられる方にも問題がある
There is a problem for those who are bullied

135456.description:
You are the one who lit my path in the darkness. Graduation is near, and while many people are looking towards the future, Chiho is the only one who hasn't been able to leave the past behind. All the things I wanted to do are closed to me... I'll at least gracefully send off the person I love.

(Source: Shonen Jump+, translated)

135457.description:
Souichi Kinoshita, a magazine journalist, came to a Western confectionary shop run by twin brothers to write an article. Although the interview with the pâtissier Reizei Jin had just begun, for some reason, Jin struggled to answer and the interview quickly dwindled to an awkward silence. That's when the other brother in the pair of twins, Ai, tells him about Jin's past…?

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: ウィークエンドシトロン

135459.description:
Aspiring novelist Kim Woojin has been a side character all his life. He can't write stories that are his own, and he's not even his boyfriend, Minho's, priority. But like every cloud has its silver lining, Woojin’s comes in the form of an aspiring stage actor, Taehwan. However, Taehwan is not without his own problems: he suffers from terrible stage fright that keeps him from taking lead roles.

A friendship blossoms between Woojin and Taehwan, with each helping the other overcome their fears. Will this newfound friendship remain just that or could Taehwan be the spark that gets Woojin’s creative juices flowing again? And could they both muster up the courage to become the protagonists of their own stories?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: 一塌糊涂的爰情 Rotten Love

135461.description:
To save her family's bankrupt business, Arisa was forced into an arranged marriage. But before that, she asked the boss that she admired, Shuugo, to take her virginity. Shuugo assured her that he would take good care of her. "I didn't realize you had such a seductive body." His sweet kisses and passionate caresses made her experience climax as if her whole body was being electrified. This happiness was only supposed to be temporary, and Arisa had made up her mind to live only with the memories of the night of passion. But then Shuugo suddenly proposed to her, "Marry me"...?

(Source: Printemps Shupan, translated)

title.native: 10億円の契約花嫁 過保護な御曹司と秘書の淫靡な結婚
title.romaji: 10 Oku-en no Keiyaku Hanayome Kahogona Onzoushi to Hisho no Inbina Kekkon

135463.description:
I like you senpai ♡
I don't need anything else...

Meru used to think love was a trifling matter, but then she met a petite "senpai" with a strong sense of justice and fell in love. She's very affectionate for senpai, but her love may be going a little bit overboard.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: ヤンデレめる子ちゃんはせんぱいがお好き
title.romaji: Yandere Meruko-chan wa Senpai ga Osuki

135464.description:
Left paralyzed after a brutal beating, Lee Gwak masters the ultimate somatic art that restores his body. No longer content with mediocracy, he vows to rise beyond an ordinary martial artist and become a true warrior.

(Source: Toomics)

135465.description:
There's a such moment in your life. All of a sudden, you happen to look the world through a pastel tone filter from a high-teen romance film, and the moment when the sunlight through leaves gets brighter. The moment when a blink of an eye clearly reflects one single person for a long time.

In other words, this is a story about recognizing our first love and a process of telling the feeling.

135466.description:
In his youth, Minjae released Genie, the spirit of the lamp, and gained three magical wishes. Though most would quickly use their wishes, Minjae held on to his far longer than most humans due to his bond with Genie. But now Genie feels torn between his duties and his affection for Minjae. Things get even more complicated when the Lamp Corp, a group in charge of Genie, sends Yuri to investigate their relationship. Can the handsome Genie get a handle on his magical duties and his burgeoning feelings for Minjae?

(Source: Tapas)

135469.description:
Unbeknownst to them, Min and Hyunwoo have been in one another's life since they were little. Min is a TV producer who has been demoted to the entertainment division for defending his colleague. Hyunwoo is a K-pop idol who has fallen from grace after his controversy over an assault against a fellow idol. The two lost souls develop feelings for each other while producing a variety show.

(Source: NETCOMICS)

135470.description:
Since he was a child, Kang Dokyung has been able to see an eeire black smoke that caused people to get hurt. One day, he runs into a man covered in this smoke, who turns out to be his infamous school sunbae Park Woohyun. Though wary of his cold demeanor at first, Dokyung is surprised to find out that whenever he touches Woohyun, the smoke disappears. Ecstatic to finally use his special gift for some good, Dokyung is determined to help his sunbae to get rid of the darkness surrounding him.

(Source: Tapas)

135471.description:
Jae-In, a key figure in an illegal gang and a big brother, disappears after a decisive battle with the Yuksa. Four years later, YuNan, who followed Jae-In, reunites with his hyung... The relationship between the hyung who wears a hypermarket apron and the dongsaeng who doesn't seem serious?! Jae-In, who buried his past and walks the path of child-rearing, Yu-Nan, who had only chased his heart and obsession, and the hilarious Ron-Na, a cute little girl who has an unusual language ability.

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

135472.description:
Yoon-woo, an actor known mostly for bit parts, finally lands a lead role in a famous director’s next feature! The only problem? He’s starring opposite Nam Jihyuk - his a-list ex-lover. As Yoon-woo becomes more invested in his role, he finds himself unable to parse fantasy from reality: is Jihyuk's flirtatious behavior and passion him trying to win Yoon-woo back? Or he is simply acting the part? As the two struggle to reconcile their past issues, will they be able to find paradise again in one another's embrace?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes an April Fools Day Special and Halloween Special.

135473.description:
"I just want to tell him how I feel!"

Mi-Na has been planning on telling Yeo-Myung she likes him. But every time she goes to confess, something foils her plans. It turns out Yeo-Myung and Young-Woong, her best friend, were actually plotting to kill her. But why?!

(Source: Manta)

135475.description:
Mangaka Mimika Ito tells anecdotes about changes in their lifestyle since the start of the corona virus pandemic.

Originally published on Twitter and Pixiv as "Shingata Virus ni yoru Shinyoushiki no Lifestyle no Henka de Ijyuu Kimemashita", now serialised in Asahi Shinbun Shuppan's Nemuki+.

Shingata Virus ni yoru Shinyoushiki no Lifestyle no Henka de Ijyuu Kimemashita

A chilling, unforgettable taste…

135484.description:
Getting struck by lightning, breaking a bone, failing examsㅡthese are the "accidents" that happen when one becomes friends with Jia. Bringing bad luck to people has been a condition of Jia's for as long as she can remember... until she meets Gun and Hyunㅡtwo mysterious brothers who happen to be wizards! With the help of magic, she's determined to ward off her curse no matter what. But does Jia realize what kind of sorcery she's actually getting herself into?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

135485.description:
Yusei's a college student who dotes way too much on his younger sister Miyako!!
One day, he meets Arisu, a friendly, handsome young man who's close to his sister. Thinking Arisu was a phony, Yusei's surprised when they go out for drinks and find they get along. The next thing he knows, though, they're in a hotel room together... Arisu suddenly transforms into a black-hearted hottie!!
Arisu gets Yusei off, then takes pictures to use as blackmail!

He won't show Miyako, so long as Yusei becomes his boyfriend...

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Alice Has My Brother In His Sights
title.native: お兄ちゃんはアリス君に弱い

135486.description:
He's called the shrine medium. Minami Yuki has a special ability to extract the malice that he sees in others... The assignments are only executed for clients, but one day, Minami sees Taiga Donoue and removes the malice that befalls him. Feeling a sense that he has never before experienced, Minami is confused.

At the same time, Taiga is interested in Minami and has him checked out. It's then that he starts to consider ways to make Minami his. The title work series plus a standalone on two high school boys trying their hand at getting cozy for the first time.

The new work is a tight story of the characters in love after the series ended!

(Source: Renta!)

135487.description:
Set in the Taishou era, Heigo Kurasawa, the son of a trading company president, reunites with Isamu Sakaguchi, his childhood friend from 10 years ago.

They both used to play together like brothers but now they are master and servant. Heigo is left feeling lonely because of Isamu's now unfamiliar politeness. In order to restore their past relationship, Heigo tries to treat Isamu not as a servant but as a friend instead. However, one day, Isamu discovered old love letters addressed to Heigo from a man. Heigo was upset by this discovery and when Isamu comes to hold him in his arms, he whispers...

"I will never tell anyone about this. So, please let me be the only one you open up to about this worry..."

135488.description: Haruka Usano is a pastry chef trying to preserve the shop that she inherited from her grandfather. The store's sales are declining and she spends her days scrambling to pay off debts. One day, the yakuza boss suddenly barges into the store and demands repayment her debts. If you can't pay back the money, pay with your body, he says forcefully…

title.native: ヤクザの極甘調教 三代目に毎日味見されてます…。

Adorable Ikumi is such a thoughtful guy! He’s willing to dress up like his friends’ fantasy girlfriend and fulfill their every wish! But what will happen when the flirty fun becomes a truly fierce competition?

Will You Be My Cute Crossdresser? plays for keeps with sweet tales of friendship, first dates…and surprise seduction! Will an accomplished actress give a stellar performance to save the film club? And can a haunted house become a hot spot for a hook-up?

(Source: Project Hentai)

135491.description:
Wohn Ku is a vampire that needs human blood to survive. As a tenderhearted child, she led a tortured existence until a girl named Seyeon willingly became her steady blood source. Seyeon stood by Wohn throughout their school years, defending her from bullies. Fast forward to the present where they move in together ahead of their freshman year of college. Seyeon remains fiercely protective of her friend, but Wohn is ready for a fresh start. When a devoutly religious sophomore girl named Juyi showers her with kindness, Wohn emerges from her shell only to realize that Juyi had once been her father’s kidnapping victim, a potential blood source she had refused to bite. Juyi grows closer to Wohn without remembering the incident, fueling jealousy in Seyeon. Will Juyi prove to be a savior washing away Wohn’s guilt, or will she ruin a vampire’s dream of redemption?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

135492.description:

135493.description:
The protagonist, a "magical biologist" who studies creatures that can use magic, rescues a man, Ammolite, who was attacked by a magical creature, the Jewel Beetle. In order to recover Ammolite's memories stolen by the jewel beetle, the two set out on a journey to find the jewel beetle...

(Source: Moae, translated)

Winner of the 7th THE GATE Shorei-sho award

135494.description:
Erma, a witch, lives alone on the outskirts of the village. In exchange for protecting the village from demons, she demands a high price that heavily burdens the village. One day, a girl comes to Erma and asks to be her apprentice...?

135495.description:
A kind girl who had just fallen in love was forced to become a gangster's mistress for five years to pay her parents debts. When she tried to escape, she was beaten and abandoned in an alley, where a mysterious man saved her. But she didn't know the rich and handsome stranger only saved her because she looks just like his lover who disappeared long ago...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.english: This Love is Not For Sale

135496.description:
Medical examiner and virgin Han Yeonu's suspects that his corpse is the victim of a homosexual serial killing. He tries to inform Cha Dohyeon, the district attorney in charge of the case, but in the process almost becomes a victim himself. Dohyeon offers Yeonu to stay with him as the killer is on the loose. While together, the two start unleashing the lust they'd suppressed ever since their first encounter, as Dohyeon takes the lead and Yeonu finds comfort in his arms.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: Chapter count includes 13 side stories.

135497.description:
Due to the circumstances of my life, I, a boy named Lu Zhun, put on a skirt, a wig, stuffed two tangerines in my shirt, and pretended to be a girl to a boy named Mu Junchen. The “moneybag” Mu Junchen was both rich and romantic, so why did he have to fall for an “unconfident female high-school dropout” like me? After all the fights and resistance, he finally pushed me to the end of the road...

Hui-Yong finally confesses to his friend Su-Min, who he had a crush on since high school. However, Su-Min runs away after the sudden confession and Hui-Yong drinks himself into a stupor. The day after, he suddenly wakes up at his scary senior Han-Gyeol's house..

Elt, who was reborn into an MMORPG as an aristocrat, was branded as incompetent and was exiled to become a manager of a remote area with zero territories.

However, his "plant magic" was the best all-purpose magic for territorial development! As he cultivated by utilizing the magic that produces from crops to buildings and the knowledge of the previous life, the territory increased and became prosperous

Moreover, the territory that should have nothing is actually a treasure trove.

A pioneering adventure in a different world, the start of the manga adaptation!

The only joy in Viss’ life, while working as a delivery man for the Chinese restaurant Miss Lan China, is when once every three days he gets violently involved with the mysterious handsome man Graven. One day, while musing why Graven would lust after his plain self, Viss, who went to a motel after getting a call from Graven, received the blood-stained body of a man as a gift. The reeking smell of blood caused him to faint, and when he woke up, Graven confessed something shocking to the confused Viss.

Chisa spends her days managing the family bakery with her older brother (and the store's idol dog, Ms. Shibasaki). It might seem like everything's going well for her and that her dreams came true, but there's actually something troubling her. That is... that her life rhythm is too different from her boyfriend's...!! Her boyfriend, Natsuki, has also realized his dream and is currently working day and night as an apprentice veterinarian. A manga artist who is stressed due to deadline for his manga, rushes to a convenience store called "Space Convenience Store," that sells everything. 135534.description: On his previous trip to India, aging but irrepressible manga author Yukichi Yamamatsu overcame illness, pickpockets, and a formidable language barrier to successfully publish the first-ever translation of a Japanese comic into Hindi. Now he's back—running an udon noodle cart in the Delhi slums, hanging out with drug dealers, performing standup comedy in the park, and trying his best to fit in with the locals in rural Purvanchal.

135542.description: Hot-blooded highschool girl, Asuka Matsumoto, struggles as the manager of a card shop in place of her father. Even so, aiming for Asuka's special cards, are the members of the card gang "Crown" who will attack one after another. Overcome the forthcoming formidable opponents in a hot-blooded fight!
