135544.description:
Ashilee Kaltanias is reborn as a side character in a novel. As an abandoned princess, she lives in secluded luxury until she discovers a book that predicts her death. Trying to find the key to survival, she ventures out of her palace only to attract the attention of Castor, the bloodthirsty crown prince. When Castor murders her as prophesied, Ashilee finds herself in an endless time loop that restarts when Castor kills her. How many more times must she die before she finds a way to live?

(Source: Tapas)

135545.description:
On his deathbed, the Great Philosopher expressed remorse, as he was never able to learn magic.

Five hundred years later, he was reborn as Mazel Loran, the son of a feudal lord. His family believe him to be a late bloomer in terms of his magic, but also think he’s the next incarnation of the Great Philosopher. But Mazel has a secret that nobody else knows: while he does not have any magic, he has experience with “physical" force!

(Source: REX Comics, translated)

El Gran Mago con Cero de Magia

Gi-Cheol, after completing his training camp, is tasked by his battalion commander's wife to tutor their second daughter. However, he also has to soothe the loneliness of the wife and three daughters.

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

135547.description:
Between two rivals, love finds a way.

Nam Goong Yun is sickly with a bad temper. He wakes up one day to find he has traveled ten years back in time into the body of Baek Mo Ran, whom he used to bully! The years pass, and Yun finally regains control of his own body. But the question remains: Where was Mo Ran during all that time?

(Source: Manta)

title.english: Flowers Find a Way to Bloom

135550.description:
What if your partner wanted to break up… Unless you were willing to degrade him? Nanho just wants a normal relationship. As long as his lover has a handsome face, he’s happy. His boyfriend, Myungjoon, is beautiful but can’t get off unless he’s being criticized. Myungjoon’s hot brother, Su-an, also likes Nanho but he needs a partner that’s into hardcore S&M. These three difficult people must navigate the struggle of meeting their own romantic requirements or end up frustrated and alone.

(Source: Tapas)

135551.description:
At school Kaname is flawless, handsome, and popular, however, his hobby is cross-dressing. With the assistance of his sister who is a beautician and his mother who is a designer, he enjoys his weekends going out in super high level female clothing. Walking downtown as usual in female clothing, Kaname happens to meet his beloved Shizuku-chan... moreover, she doesn't realize it's him?!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

The sweet (?) romance of a chick who flew in search of a lovely angel!

title.english: The Bakery of the Chick and the Angel

135553.description: He was perfect and had incredible beauty but a demon stole his beauty. To break the spell, he is convinced that he must kiss Prince Charming within the year!

135554.description:
Please let this be a bad dream! Our protagonist wakes up to find herself in the world of a novel she wrote in middle school—one she's tried to burn to ashes! Follow Rayna Solei as she navigates her new reality with her loyal servants and a trusty black dragon! Will she ever find her way out of the novel and back to real life?

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: 公女が黒歴史を消す方法

135557.description:
The west wind, waves, the first day of spring, snowstorms, the tidal breeze, the setting sun, the withering of the trees. The dry lyricism of boys and girls, delicately and brilliantly described by the popular author.

(Source: Chikuma Shobou, translated)

135558.description:
After a bad break up with his first love, Jin-U falls into a creative slump with his ceramic art. During this slump he meets Colton, an alpha with whom he has a history. As things get steamy, it’s clear that they both have an agenda. And soon enough, the situation starts to get a whole lot more complicated. It was bound to, especially when pheromones are involved…

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

135559.description:
Jihyuk doesn’t do boyfriends, only one-night stands. So, when he’s on the prowl one night for someone to warm his bed…he gets punched in the face instead. The reason? He’s a beta and if you haven’t heard, betas aren’t exactly in demand right now. While he’s nursing his wound in the bathroom, someone falls out of one of the stalls. It is an alpha and one clearly in rut. Jihyuk is about to call the ambulance when the alpha tells him there’s only one thing he needs: a beta. Well, that can be easily arranged. But is Jihyuk prepared to get down and dirty to help the mysterious alpha? And why does the alpha look so familiar? But more importantly, will this one-night shenanigans end at that or will this force Jihyuk to break his own rules?

(Source: Lezhin US)

135561.description:
The male lead, Gi-Go Lee, who has never lost a single time in his life, and the female lead, Ro-Ji O, who defeated him. Who will end up as the victor of this 'bet'?

In a world famous restaurant, many delicacies are provided, and it’s also a heaven for all the women, both young and old. The employees here, from waiters to chefs are all top elites, with great figure and appearance. Taking the delicacies as a medium, the talented young chef Lu He, with the purpose of entertaining all the female guests, leads his partners to start their legendary lives in this restaurant.

(Source: Webnovel)

I have no money, no car, no work, my life seems to be at it's tip... "God! Please please give me a hottie and take me to the climax of my life!!" ——As if the summon was heard upon, a boy fell from the ceiling and the cake loving Zhen Tian’s greeting was surprisingly...the taste(a)of (French) the(kiss) lips!!? What do you mean it doesn't taste good?!! Hmph!

135569.description: Chiba Prefecture's millionaire Kujukuri Gosaku established the long-awaited professional baseball team "Chiba Pirates." The team comprised most prominent players from Chiba prefecture, but the team funds ran out due to extravagant nature of Gosaku and the management of the team deteriorated. The Team soon became the lowest ranked baseball team. The remaining players are determined and optimistic, but escape from the bottom is far away.

135570.description:
Emilia, the daughter of Queen Snow White, falls in love with Luka, a prince from a neighboring country who was in love with Snow White!
The black-hearted prince, who had given up on on love after being rejected by Snow White, is now being aggressively courted by the innocent girl!
The child of the pure-hearted king and the innocent Snow White turns out to be quite the little princess!
It's the beginning of a new pure-love story with an age difference!

(Source: Pixiv, translated)

135573.description:
A series of mature and bittersweet stories about love and food.

Note: Originally published as a one-shot in the 2019 #4 issue of Young King, then expanded to an 8-part serialization from the #7 to #14 issues. Serialization resumed in the 2019 #22 issue.

135574.description:
After dying at the hands of her backstabbing superior, money-grubbing Judith learned the hard way that bounty is never worth bloodshed. When she somehow finds herself alive and well, six years prior to her death, she decides to use her second chance at life to abandon her greed and become a genuine knight. She begins by accepting Captain Kaillou Lewalmeigh’s offer to join the honorable Order of Red Knights. Will Judith be able to redeem herself by overcoming the wrongdoings of her past?

(Source: Tapas)

Venus loses his memories after an accident and dreams the same dream every day. In his dreams, the same person appears. Two people who want something back. Do they meet by coincidence? Or perhaps it is something more?

(Source: Mr. Blue)

An official spin-off for the Senki Zesshou Symphogear series!

The divas' next battlefield is a warm gourmet comedy by the chief kitchen maid, Shirabe!

Please enjoy another Symphogear story, told through cooking! ♪

135581.description:
Otaku salaryman, Momose, who loves fantasy and parallel worlds, comes upon a book that he used to read a lot in the past: “The Complete Collection of Summoning Magic”. Feeling nostalgic, his middle-schooler heart re-ignites, so he decides to try and chant once again the summoning spell to call The Servant of Fate... But suddenly, in doing so, a demon named Keiha comes out of his closet?!

(Source: Media Factory, translated)

A shy and simple Sweets loving boy, Hodaka-kun and his secret hobby, making sweets. One day while he was eating his home-made Madeleines during Hanami, he found his company's idol Yamana collapsed at his door. Not knowing what to do, he gave him some water and Madeleines. Yamana loved the Madelaines Hodaka made so much that he started bothering him at the office the very next day. Hodaka, who started to feel cornered decided to invited Yamana to his house and....!?

135590.description: "This wand will bring you 'fortune', I'm sure." Lulu is an incredibly positive girl, who is overflowing with dreams and hopes. She aspires to become a magician after falling in love with her grandmother's magic. However, she was not born with an 'element', like everyone else who is able to use magic, which becomes a hurdle for her to achieve her dream. In the world renowned "Mils Clare Academy", in the magic capital Latium, Lulu goes through daily struggles to harness an inner element. Friends with peculiar characteristics begin to gather around her. Every day she seems to find herself involved in all kinds of happy(?) trouble. Based on the incredibly popular otome game by Otomate, Wand of Fortune is now reintroduced in manga format.

title.native: ワンド オブ フォーチュン

135591.description:
The story takes place in Japan, right now, where the Coronavirus has completely changed our way of life. In the house of a young man, his childhood friend who lost his job due to the Coronavirus moves in. However, this childhood friend is a scumbag...

The story depicts the depressing feeling of not knowing how long the coronavirus will last, and the rotten relationship between the two young men.

Tanba and Utagawa have been together for over ten years, but Uta still can’t believe he’s landed such a stud, and Tanba still gets blindsided when his young-at-heart boyfriend switches into adult mode. It’s a non-stop whirlwind of love that sends both their hearts skipping!

In the tenth world, he is just an common beggar. Unexpectedly the world’s number one Sect, ZiChen Zhenren took him in under his wing, causing many people to sob endlessly. And this lifetime, he once again is in a pure Yang body. In secret, a dark pair of eyes unconsciously watches over him.

Flower shop owner Hanayo Shiratori is rescued from a rowdy customer by a wild-looking bad boy named Kasumi. What's more, her parents are planning to marry her off to this scary guy as part of a business venture! At first, she believes he's just as put off by the arrangement as she is, but when he suddenly declares he'll make her fall for him and starts touching all her sensitive places, he knocks her off her feet. Literally. His touch may be bestial, but her moans are so sweet! Kasumi insists that by the time they walk down the aisle, he will capture her heart!

He wasn't her type, but... while in a daze, they registered their marriage, moved in together, and even had their first night! Kokoro resisted, but he said to her, "You can't run anyway, so why not accept it?" His attitude took a 180 degree turn...

His true face, when his glasses are taken off, is sadistic... and hot. As her private parts were attacked over and over with squelches ringing through the room, she couldn't bear it anymore! Furthermore, his thing which had gotten big pushed against her that place, and thus...

135624.description: One day, our protagonist is assigned to be a mentor to the president's son, Taiga Narukami, an elite boy with a shiny new look. However, Taiga becomes frustrated with Airu's uncompromising attitude, and finally takes her lips in a forceful manner. Airu's body gets wet under Taiga's rough kisses and fingertips. When Narukami-kun touches her, her body becomes so numb that she can't think about anything else...!

Five Seconds Before My/One's First Love ~ Worn-Out Lady in Her Thirties Is Stirred up by an Alpha Prince

135630.description:
One day, Emi, an apprentice pâtissière, suddenly found herself in another world where evil spirits were abound. As she was about to be attacked by a beast, she was saved by a handsome knight. She makes some pudding to thank him, and by chance it was discovered that the sweets made by Emi were able to purify evil spirits! Dumbfounded by this, a shrine was set up in her name and she became known as the legendary purification princess?!

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)
synonyms: The Saintess of Another World Is a Pâtissière
The Princess Priestess from the Other World Is a Patissier

title.native: 異界の姫巫女はパティシエール

135631.description:
Student council president Terano is confident and smart. On the other hand, the good-looking, but scary Kumazaki has been failing classes for the past few years. One day, a friend catches Terano texting someone. Terano remains quiet on the subject... No one would have guessed that the rebellious Kumazaki is actually quite shy, and is completely wrapped around Terano's finger...

(Source: KUMA)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

135632.description:
Leigh travels to the royal capital in search of his father’s whereabouts and is introduced by the headmaster to a job as a royal tutor. What he doesn't expect was that Prince Potter is a barbaric half-beast imprisoned in a tower who can't even speak human languages. Unable to leave the tower, Leigh is locked up inside and tasked with teaching the Prince courses according to the instructions and objects that come through the door...

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Chapter count includes 3 extras.

135633.description:
Collection of seven short stories:
1. Rose Tea Ceremony (ローズティーセレモニー); 1976
2. Kyabetsu Choucho (きゃべつちょうちょ); 1976
3. Page One (ページ１); 1977
4. Shigatsu Kaidan (四月怪談); 1979
5. Hinagiku Monogatari (雛菊物語); 1980

135634.description:
“I know I am no match for him, but these feelings are overflowing out…!!”
Four girls have fallen in love with boys older than them: the four Odagiri, each one with their own great personality.
To be avoided, to love, and to be loved too much (!?)… This is the start of four love stories, of four girls who can’t hold back their feelings and are making their way to the adult world!

title.native: オダギリさんには、キリキリ舞い

135635.description:
The powerful God of War, Zhou Quan, is poisoned to death by his useless son. When he opens his eyes again, he realizes that not only has his adopted son imprisoned him and stolen the throne, but he had been reincarnated as his useless son?! And this adopted son who has once been loyal and devoted to him is actually deeply in love with his former self and even treats the current him as a substitute for the former self.

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: With All Kins, Have No Pity

title.english: With All Kins, Have No Pity

135637.description:
To me, it was love at first sight. To you, your love grew with time! As corporate slaves in the finance department, they always work overtime and stay up all night together whilst love develops along the way! Liang Xiao: "Senior, you're destined to be loved by me."

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

135638.description:
A walking, talking mannequin. Is this an opportunity to use, or an opportunity to be used? Bo-Ra simply wants a chance to get close to the fashion designer, Hong-Rin Da. Yet it would seem that Hong-Rin wants something more from Bo-Ra. Will Bo-Ra’s struggles to become a fashion designer pull at Hong-Rin’s heartstrings? If she even has any to begin with...

(Source: WEBTOONS)

135639.description:
“What am I? The dog that stays by your side.”
The youngest son of the Chairman of one of the leading business groups in the country, Song Se-Yeon, grew up in a warm family. That is, until one day he loses his parents in sudden fire, and his only brother goes mad. When his whole world is crashing down on him, the Vice Chairman, Kim Su-Hyeok, appears as Se-Yeon’s guardian. In order to protect his family and his only brother, Se-Yeon chooses to become Su-Hyeok’s puppet...
Then, on his twentieth birthday, he receives a letter saying, "I’ll help you escape.”
As if bewitched by the promise of freedom, he visits the address mentioned in the letter, only to meet a mysterious man, Lee Hyun, who offers to be his master.

(Source: Lezhin)
synonyms: From Now On, I'm Your Dog

title.english: I’ll be your dog starting today

135640.description: Hyun-Ho has been single all her life and falls in love way too easily. But when love strikes again and she falls for the guy at the swimming pool, will her love life finally bloom?

135642.description:
Five years ago, Hyun-Ju suffered from post-traumatic stress disorder and dissociative memory disorder due to an incident. Nevertheless, Hyun-Ju, who is continuing his bright college life, appears in front of his friend, Min-Jun, who went to study in the United States. Unlike the shy high school days, Min-Jun approaches Hyun-Ju without hesitation, perhaps due to American influence, and now Hyun-Ju feels unfamiliar with Min-Jun - his heart is shaken. But the longer he spends time with Min-Jun, the more the past that has sunk deep in his memory begins to come back to life!

(Source: Kakao)

title.native: 絶体絶命でんぢゃらすじーさん

135646.description: Tazuru Kazami is a death row inmate who murdered 89 people in just a few years. With her murders gaining a reputation as beautiful "art," the number of copycat crimes has recently skyrocketed and become a social problem. In the midst of this, the imprisoned Kazami offers to hand over information about the copycats on the condition that she speak to a certain someone. The young man she chooses is a run-of-the-mill college student.

title.native: マーディスト-死刑囚・風見多鶴-

135647.description: A gnome woman arrives in a city where various races coexist. However, despite being touted as a "diverse city," everything, from traffic lights to roads and shops, is designed based on the standards of a typical race...

135648.description:
Two people who hate to lose, in love?!

“Let’s go out with me, not my brother.”

I just wanted to get to know him, but he suddenly came to me asking me to go out with him instead of hyung, so I agreed thinking that I would make him try really hard. However, once we get to know each other, unexpected feelings begin to arise... a tight and sweet love battle between two male high schoolers who cannot back down.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

One such borrower is Mr. Hisayama, but as luck would have it, Shimoga and Naiya find him murdered in his home. Directly from the “Violent 01” team, Detectives Han Jeoung-yu, our prodigy son, and Seo Haeso, wild mad dog, make their appearance! Ready for anything to find answers! From infiltrating a club frequented by the most powerful businessmen in the country to ... Competing in a passionate kissing contest for a luxury watch?! Get ready! That your covert mission… is about to begin!

(Source: KTOON, translated)

135772.description:
On his way to school, Feng Ming lost his life to save a child and somehow "transmigrated" into the body of West Thunder Nation's Crown Prince in a different universe. However, this Crown Prince was not as highly respected as Feng Ming expected; moreover, he seemed to be in an unusual relationship with Prince Regent, Rong Tian. Later, Rong Tian realized that the Crown Prince actually harbored a different soul in his body. Coupled with the incredible ideas Feng Ming would blurt out sometimes, Rong Tian started finding Feng Ming more and more interesting…

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

title.english: A Phoenix on the Ninth Floor of Heaven

135773.description: This world embraces various miraculous beings. The nine countries sharing this world stand on the land, seabed and even in the sky, with each one featuring its own characteristics. Humans, yokais and celestial beings coexist here. However, for some reasons, the balance among the three was thrown off, and yokais, with their power multiplied, are attempting to take over this world. The appearance of our hero Song will bring significant influence to this world, yet he has a long way to go.

135774.description: What our protagonist Neo enjoys doing everyday is loudly preaching his father's adventures above the Cloud Sea. Nobody believed that these stories were true, and all called his father a liar who deceived the public to gain fame. In order to prove his father's innocence, Neo resolves to break through the obstruction of the Cloud Sea and find out the truth. On his journey, he discovers that the Cloud Sea’s existence is not what it seems, and that the companion who he deemed to be a friend, may also be an enemy…

title.native: アオハル共は拗らせている
転生王子は（学園でも）ダラけたい

135779.description:
Shinwoo is fed up with people asking him if he’s going out with Juho. It doesn’t matter what others say or think; he has accepted that fact that Juno always has been - and always will be - nothing more than a good friend…even if Shinwoo wants them to be something more. Sure, he might have been crushing on Juno for no less than 10 years, but that doesn’t change the reality of the situation: Juho is simply not interested in men, and their friendship is more important than a little crush. However, a confession by Juho is about to shock Shinwoo to the core: his supposedly straight best friend has…a boyfriend?! But something seems more than just a bit off. Juho is always hanging out with Shinwoo instead of this “boyfriend” of his, and is seemingly hung up on his opinion of his new lover… Is this new turn of events setting Shinwoo up for failure, or could it be fate, setting Shinwoo up with the love of his life?

(Source: Lezhin)

Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.
synonyms: Rendez-Vous Sur le Pont des Amoureux
意地っ張りな織田くんは素直になれない

135780.description:
Hold on, Crown Prince! Why are you doing this to me?! With a charming face and a not-quite-so attitude, not a day passes in the life of a beautiful boy Ray without some trouble. Seeing Ray get repeatedly fired from various jobs due to his fiery temper, Edward lets him in on a must-have item(!) for noble ladies that is sure to bring in a big sum of money. While searching through the forest for the material for the item, Ray is injured, though lightly, by an arrow out of nowhere. He runs away refusing any treatment. The arrow's owner is none other than Crown Prince Lucas of Luvecia. Having saved Ray from his troubles time and again, Lucas makes an offer Ray can't refuse--the terms of which dictate that his life will be spared, should he grant Lucas his wishes.

(Source: Tappytoon, translated)
synonyms: เดี๋ยวนะ องค์ชายรัชทายาท!

135781.description:
After a promising debut, Seohyun’s fallen out of the fashion world spotlight with his latest designs. His short career’s practically over as the industry writes him off. Yet even as people refuse to work with him, Hyowon Lee agrees to be his model. While this playboy troublemaker doesn't seem serious enough for Seohyun's liking, he does have a certain allure to him. Will Hyowon be more trouble than he’s worth or will their partnership give rise to something more tantalizing... and pleasurable?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one prologue, one epilogue, three extras and five side story chapters.

135782.description:
"Why don't we ------ ?"

Jung Dahoon laughed out loud at a joke his longtime friend Gu Junhee made. However, Junhee had a strange expression on his face. After that day, their relationship, which was nothing more than steady friends, began to drift in a different direction. Can they be more than just friends?

A soft and endlessly sweet BL of one's youth starts now~ ♡♡

(Source: Bookcube, translated)

Note: includes 1 extra chapter.

135783.description:
Seo Jeong-In, the second son of a wealthy judge's family, fails to get into the university his father wants, unlike his older brother. Consequently, he ends up in a dormitory at a rural cram school catering to upper-class students. Having been aware of his sexual identity from an early age, Jeong-In has been enjoying a free-spirited and indulgent gay lifestyle. However, things turn for the worse when his dorm roommate, Seung-Hyun, captures footage of Jeong-In in a sticky situation with his friend Han Min-Woo using a hidden camera installed in their room...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes five side story chapters.

135785.description: They started off as a purely physical relationship, with neither knowing much about the other. Suddenly, he finds out that the other is a fan of his novels! At this point, it's too late to come out with the truth, so he's got to act as though he's his own fan?!

He finds a boy, Mikami Ran, who has hidden talent for boxing. Moriyama trains him to turn him into a world champion. Boxing depicted in this work is not only on the glamorous side, but also on the dark side that is the underworld.

135795.description: A hard-boiled rock music manga that depicts the rock vocalist Odyssey returning to Japan from the United States. Odyssey spends his days wandering around with the former members who are hoping for a band reunion. However, driven by his inner impulse, he picks up the guitar again and resumes band activities.

Akane was recommended as a parts model for a special feature on bondage, so despite her fear about this porn-like job when she's never had a boyfriend before she goes to the studio for the first meeting. 135798.description: Ise and Shima, both in their fourth year of working, are sharing a room. In order to escape their boring lives, they decide to "challenge" each other every month to do various things. One day, the challenge is to "fall in love"? Be cute! The challenge is to become a more conscious member of society! This is a comedy about living together, where every day turns into something fun little by little!

135802.description:
Pent up and tired of her apathetic girlfriend, Asahina Yuni turns to an anonymous online account to let it all out. It’s just another day of doomscrolling after class when Asahina gets swept away in conversation with the beautiful, outgoing Taki. When Taki turns out to be following Asahina’s private account, it’s cute…right? Taki would never blackmail Asahina…right? With every new lie, the web of secrets and erotic desire grows ever-tighter!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

135803.description:
Nekozuka Serina is a serious third-year high school student who’s studying hard to qualify for a scholarship. Her cute and stylish looks, however, don’t exactly meet the school dress code—which Tachibana Reiko, a member of the disciplinary committee, is always on her case about. Plus, no matter how much Serina tries, Reiko always bests her in grades and athletics. One day, however, Serina spots Reiko meeting with an unknown woman after school…and going to a love hotel! What will happen between Serina and Reiko now that they share a secret?

(Source: Seven Seas Enterainment)

135804.description:
Gotou-san, the most beautiful girl in school, keeps messing with Maeda-kun, the boy sitting in front of her. She has a secret crush on him, but her intentions are lost on Maeda-kun, who has no confidence in himself. What will be the outcome of Gotou-san's single-minded crush?

This is the long-awaited collected volume of a tense love story with many new illustrations!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes five intermission chapters.
synonyms: Gotou-san wants me to turn around

title.native: 後藤さんは振り向かせたい!

135805.description:
Meg Valentine might be the Teacher of the Year, but instead of finding herself a great beach to lounge on, she's spending her vacation time helping out her sister by taking care of her clothing shop. When infamous actress Taylor Gee, star of Many Moons and many tabloids, comes in demanding a dress for an event, Meg might make a whole week's worth of sales in one day of dealing with this diva. She may sell more than dresses when it comes to her bodyguard, the handsome and dashing Jaret Miller. Will all outfits be half-off, or just Meg's?

(Source: Harlequin)

Note: Includes a bonus story.

135807.description:
After losing everything, the Nakata brothers find a mysterious app that offers a chance to make large sums of money. But are they ready for the danger they must now face, the deadly monsters known as WORLDs...?

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: What This World Is Made Of
title.native: セカイはアレでデキテイル

135808.description:
When Meguru goes with his family to visit his grandparents in the countryside, he learns too late that there is no wireless charging technology anywhere near them. Makoto’s batteries will only last another two days unless he finds a way to charge them. Though he’s disappointed that he won’t get to celebrate New Year’s with his beloved android, he’s also alarmed at his body’s reactions when Makoto gets close to him. It wasn’t like this when he was little, so does this mean that Meguro has romantic feelings for his robot? On the way back home, Meguro leans in to give Makoto a sweet kiss before he wakes up...

(Source: Futekiya)

title.native: あなたが寝ている間に

135809.description:
The most dangerous arch-villain learned martial arts from cheap books of useless techniques? But his spiritual aura’s rejuvenating power is overflowing from within. A confrontation between traditional martial arts and supernatural power begins.

(Source: QQ, translated)

135810.description:
"I promise I'll make our first night together pain-free, okay?"

A loving couple struggles to have sex, but could today be different...?

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.romaji: Itoshii Kimi to no Shoya Jijou.

135811.description:
One lonely Christmas Eve, Yoriko Fujieda, a talent production manager, discovers handsome high-school boy Taichi Ogino crying in the park. He agrees to join her agency, and like running a three-legged race, the pair stumble ahead through the entertainment industry. Seven years later, Taichi is a megastar! But, life isn't perfect. "It's your fault I still haven't done it, Yoriko..."

This is the story of a manager who takes responsibility to the next level.

(Source: Renta!)

135813.description:
The first published manga by Akira (Leiji) Matsumoto in 1954. He finished this work in november 1953 and sent it to drawing contest "Shinjin ō" , organized by the Manga Shounen magazine. Matsumoto was fifteen when he won this contest and began his mangaka career.

In 2018, an Italian and French version has been printed, with the agreement of Matsumoto sensei.

In 2021, the Italian version has been reprinted by the "Leiji Matsumoto Cultural Association".

In Japan it was republished in 2014 in a collection of previously unpublished works 蜜蜂の冒険 松本零士 未発表・初期作品集.

135814.description: Youta Chiba enrolls in a co-ed school, formerly an all-girls school, in order to get a girlfriend. However, the girls are obsessed with the handsome guy in his class, Manato Yoshizawa, and Youta loses all hope. One day, Youta witnesses Manato being confessed to, and decides to ask Manato to teach him how to be popular...!

135815.description:
Seven participants, 24 hours, and individual pots of money. This is Pie Game, a reality TV show where participants’ individual pots of money grow as time flows. And when blood flows, their time grows. Marooned on a specially designed seven-floor TV set with a set of clothes and daily rations, every other item they purchase reduces their time. How will the participants increase their time on the set and how much money will they manage to leave with?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

135816.description:
Weijing runs a pharmacy in Kowloon, the notorious crime town of old Hong Kong, where he also manufactures drugs for criminal syndicates as a side business. One day, the head of the district from the syndicate leaves a random guy in his care, and Weijing is suddenly left alone with a guy whose origin, identity, and purpose are entirely shrouded in mystery. But as the two spend more time together, their curiosity about each other eventually develops into something more.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

135817.description:
The leftover cat's mission: "make my human strong without me!"

(Source: Daum Webtoon)

135818.description:
Be my husband from now on!

Masaki, who lives in a small, rural village, has been alone since his grandmother passed away and holding calligraphy lessons for children is his only diversion now.
But recently, a boy who started going to these lessons started proprosing,
"I'm your husband now!"
Masaki didn't take him seriously, but one day, after smelling Masaki's scent, out from Sakutarou's head popped...animal ears!? Is that a tail?! Until...POOF!
A young man who resembled Sakutarou, but was taller than Masaki suddenly appears...?!?! He's sniffed, he's licked, and somehow, he seems kind of dangerous?

Humans and cats... same situation, different thoughts! Doom!

Tsuge's debut work based on the Shourui Awaremi no Rei, an edict which existed in the early days of the Edo period during the reign of shogun Tokugawa Tsunayoshi. It depicts the exploits of a mysterious messenger, Hakumen Yasha, who saves people suffering due to the evil law.

(Source: Kodansha, translated and edited)

Note: Includes a prologue.

135822.description:
Jin-Hyuk is a model student. Studious. Hardworking. He can’t wait till the day he has his own place and his own car. He knows that the only way he can achieve his dreams is to go to a top-tier university. He’s fine with his repetitive daily routine of school and studying. That is, until one day, while taking a shortcut through a rougher neighborhood, he sees a kid that looks familiar. That kid… they’re in the same homeroom together, aren’t they? But he’s not the kind of person Jin-Hyuk would get mixed up with. He’s the kind of person that grows up to be a lowlife. Jin-Hyuk was raised better than that. But… that kid, what’s his name… Hee-Chan was it? He’s getting beat up by his dad. No, just keep walking. He should have nothing to do with Hee-Chan, but something seems to keep making their paths cross…

This feeling of ennui that Jin-Hyuk has, is Hee-Chan what he needs to shake it?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

135823.description: The plain and unassuming Ono and her classmate Iwama have a secret kissing relationship!?

135824.description:
"Let's date until we graduate."

U-Hyeon has a secret crush on his homeroom teacher. His best friend, Do-Ha, finds out and confesses his feelings for him. But then he makes an interesting proposition: "Go out with me. Fall for me before graduation, and I win. If you don't, you win." Can U-Hyeon like someone other than his teacher?

(Source: Manta, edited)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

135825.description: Note: Includes the one-shot "Sakura-san no Yasashii Coffee".

135827.description:
Hana, who lives on the small island of Junaru with a population of 600, loves to read to the children of the island. Mizuki senses the power of Hana's "reading", and invites her to join the Broadcasting Club, where Mizuki is the club president.

"Tell me what you really want, and I will make it come true."
"I want to join the broadcasting club."

Hana decides to join the club, and as she experiences many "firsts" with the members of the broadcasting club, it only deepen her love for reading aloud...

(Source: Ultra Jump, translated)

The story of Yasuko, the daughter of a Japanese sweets shop owner, who peeks into the incomprehensible private life of Terumi, a mysterious regular customer, and is drawn into her true identity.

135838.description:
Reborn into a fantasy novel as a wicked character fated to meet an early demise, Minjoo - now Dahlia Margaret - has a lot on her plate right from the start. But at least she’s now free of her vicious high school bully, Sooyeon. Or is she? When Dahlia meets Flore, her estranged sister and the protagonist of the novel, she is shocked to find that the girl bears a suspicious resemblance to the classmate who tormented her. Now, driven by the desire to save her own life and also get revenge, Dahlia needs to make a powerful ally, and she has her eye on a handsome royal who just might be perfect for the job. However, a deal with this mysterious man might mean more than she bargained for...

A collection of three horror stories:
1. Neko no Me Ningyou (猫の目人形);
2. Hitokui Bokki (人食い木鬼);
3. Hebi Otoko (へび男).

135847.description:
A romance about a 50-year old woman divorcing and returning home to her parents' house. There she meets a 60-year old friend from her past, who has always had a crush on her. A new - old - romance blossoms.

Notes: Originally self-published on Twitter, was then licensed by Libre for serialization.

135851.description:
Kaede is a female college student who has lived desperately with her younger brother and sister after their parents abandoned them. It was Yo-chan, a young boy who first took care of her after she had been abused and abandoned. "Itsuki-chan will be my princess." Wait a second!? The meal is mouth-to-mouth!? But I've never even had a lover...

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

135853.description:
Shimizu is feared by those around him because of his intimidating appearance. Though he secretly harbors feelings for Miyakura, the student council president, he’s been too shy to speak to her. But then one day, Miyakura suddenly approaches him—!?

(Source: Twitter, translated)

135859.description:
One day, a high school student named Kujuku bought a second-hand refrigerator. When he woke up the next day, the refrigerator has transformed into a beautiful woman! Now, Nanoi the refrigerator lady and the boy Kajuku's life as a sweet couple(?) begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: ご飯にしますか？お風呂にしますか？それとも付喪神にしますか？
title.romaji: Gohan ni Shimasu ka? Ofuro ni Shimasu ka? Soretomo Tsukumogami ni Shimasu ka?

135860.description: Tsukamoto is newly independent designer who wants his work to be printed with traditional movable printing at the Nakajima printing house. There, he meets the delinquent turned printing master, Seto. Seto's skills and knowledge are undeniable, but his insensitivity and firm opinions cause him to butt heads with Tsukamoto. As they continue to work together, Seto's passion for printing shines through, and Tsukamoto's feelings begin to change. Then one day, they receive a huge job, and the client is none other than...Tsukamoto's ex-lover, Soejima?!
synonyms: Tình yêu này không phải định mệnh

title.native: この恋は運命じゃない
title.romaji: Kono Koi wa Unmei ja Nai

135861.description:
After meeting through an online dating site, Naoki and Tomoaki had a purely physical relationship for almost a year before they finally became a proper couple. Tomoaki graduated from college and got a job, and despite their busy lives, the two men have slowly but surely grown closer together. However, when Tomoaki is sent to Osaka on a business trip, they're separated for two whole weeks. Having never spent this much time apart, it only takes a small thing to cause big trouble. Naoki's never loved anyone before, and he soon realizes he's getting a taste of something new. Feelings that began in a gelato shop melt together in sweet harmony and turn to love...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: ジェラテリアスーパーノヴァ royal vanilla

135862.description:
Yoka is the earnest student committee chairman. Igarashi is an impudent delinquent. They are in a secret relationship, and their sweet and slightly naughty love affair will heal your soul!

(Source: Sho-Comi, translated)

title.native: 恋してそっと、キスしてもっと
title.romaji: Koi Shite Sotto, Kiss Shite Motto

135863.description:
A high school girl named Hina brings a young boy named Riku along with her to a place that's been marked off-limits.

Riku feels uneasy about this, but then Hina forces her hand into his crotch and starts groping him. His knees go weak the moment he ejaculates and he falls down. Without caring about it, Hina begins to pull down her own underwear...

Haguruma-sensei writes a hot story about a high school girl who stains her hands with forbidden play!

(Source: FANZA, translated)

Note: Published in COMIC Anthurium 2021-02.

synonyms: My Sister is My Wife: Immorality volume

135868.description: Lately, novice graphic designer Miya has been troubled about work. This is indubitably a time when he'd appreciate being comforted, but his lover, Hare, has gone off on a backpacking trip and has been out-of-contact for three whole months...

135872.description: Takagi, the store manager of a flower shop, does a favor for his younger sister by going to an Idol concert to check out a man she met online. However, it turns out that this online friend is actually Toraji, a part-timer who works for Takagi.

title.native: スーパープラトニック

135873.description:
Hiroki, a single parent, is having a little trouble with his next-door neighbor. Hiroki's a very serious businessman and has absolutely nothing in common with the younger, flashy Shohei... Except Hiroki's son, Hideki, starts going to Shohei's apartment and causing trouble. Shohei criticizes Hiroki's parenting skills and even calls him sexually frustrated, so Hiroki forgets to apologize and the two get into a fight. They end up accidentally kissing, and their relationship starts heading in a new direction...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: うちの子がご迷惑かけます。
title.romaji: Uchi no Ko ga Gomeiwaku Kakemasu

135874.description:
Save room for the main course.
Hyunwook is a coward when it comes to his longtime crush Heesun, who suddenly announces that she’s getting married. He helps her plan her wedding at a restaurant called Secondo Piatto. There he meets Wonyoung, an old friend of Heesun’s fiancée. But why is Wonyoung crying on the day of the wedding?

(Source: Manta)

135875.description:
The "Ten Masters" had kept each other in check and maintained the balance of power and order of the world beyond human limits, until Baek Do-Hyeon showed up with the strongest power ever!

(Source: Naver, translated)

135876.description:
“Soho Baek” is the sole survivor of his clan when they are killed after falsely being accused of treason. Brought to the imperial palace to act as the emperor’s curse bearer, he spends his days in loneliness and pain. When Prince “Jugyul,” now the only remaining son of the emperor, appears in front of him and showers him with kindness, Soho can’t help but fall in love. Can true love genuinely exist in the imperial palace, or does Prince Jugyul have something else up his sleeve?

(Source: Copin Comics)

135877.description:
Milo is invited to go camping with eight other people during summer vacation, but he is worried when he hears that the place is where a mass murder took place a long time ago. When he arrives at the villa and walks along the lakeside with Drill, whom he befriended along the way, a mysterious old woman appears and tells him, "If you want to live, leave...". What awaits them after that are dismembered corpses stuffed into flowerpots, members being killed and maimed by a strange monster, massacres repeated over and over again in town, the prophecy of the Topi tribe who have survived, the night that never ends, the "test moon", and the magic of the "catastrophe rock". Against the Topi tribe's prophecy of genocide, what will be the fate of Milo and his friends as they fight against the monster, against the catastrophe brought about by humanity's primitive desires, fears, and emotions? The breathtaking development and the shocking ending will hit you. In addition to the main story, three prototype chapters are also included!

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

135878.description:
A detective story for young readers, which revolve around the young high school detective Momoko Aoyama, who solves smaller, episodic cases since she took over her father's detective agency. She is assisted Hitoshi Yamanaka, who apparently knew her father.

(Source: Detective Conan World Wiki)

135887.description:
Saori Otsuka, a quiet, honor student classmate, is a girl with a big body and big boobs.

Saori has one problem, it's been three months since she started going out with her boyfriend. Saori isn't very good at socializing. Even after many dates, she doesn't know how to close the distance.

According to Saori's research, a clumsy honor student, the average couple has sex about three months into their relationship, so she decides to ask her boyfriend out on a date at home.

Saori, who is an honor student, studied the video and the book, and practiced well on her own before going on sex, She'll wrap him up with her big body!

(Source: DL Site)

135890.description:
One day, out of the blue,
An emotional god appears in front of you,
offering a special ability...

Will you use the ability to dispel evil and become a force for good? Or will the blessing turn into a curse?

It would surely be up to you.

(Source: Gekkan Sunday, translated)

title.native: 神様、僕は気づいてしまった
時黒神社でまたあした

135894.description:
"Let's win the shogi championship together!" That's how Ayumu tried to start the school shogi club. To follow Tamaki, a genius player she admired , she transferred to Matsuyama High in Ehime Prefecture with the goal of building the best shogi club in the country. Her goal is to win the Ohashi Namihai, the tournament that's the gateway to a professional shogi career. To find another player, she talked to Kari, another girl said to have abilities comparable to Tamaki.

(Source: Compass, translated)

135895.description:
Prototype version of Sket Dance, published in Akamaru Jump.

The Sket Dan is a group created for the purpose of helping people. However, with there rarely being any clients, the three members Bossun, Himeko and Switch spend their days lazying around.

In walks a client, Mimori Konno. She wants someone to deliver an envelope with a heart mark in her stead which was dropped by her crush, Naoki Nishio. Bossun admonishes her to deliver it herself. However, when the Sket Dan discover that inside the envelope are pictures of half-naked girls, they change their minds completely and set out to investigate.

(Source: Sket Dance Fandom Wiki)

Originally published in Akamaru Jump supplemental volume, later republished in the SKET DANCE Koushiki Fanbook collection.
synonyms: スケット・ダンス プロトタイプ ~トラブル・ラブレター~
Sket Dance Prototype: Trouble Love Letter

135896.description:
A handsome narcissist and ladies' man, Ikezuki Touya, was instantly attracted when he laid eyes on the beautiful face of company cafeteria staff, Fujii Karen, that was hidden underneath a mask.

He invited her for a meal, instead he got a very straightforward reply, "Is that an invitation for sexual intercourse?" What more, she doesn't feel like being in a romantic relationship with anyone. On top of that, he was told that she is looking for a sex friend who can be in a physical-only relationship with her.

To love an unconventional woman, an unusual relationship between sex friends ensues! Because she is different from her usual self during sex, the kissing and pleasuring were quite bold and aggressive. But contrary to Touya who gets hooked quickly, Karen sticks with their relationship as sex friends up to the end. And then, a man who claims to be Karen's fiance appears in front of them!?

An unpredictable, heart fluttering romance between sex friends!!

title.native: 性行為を前提としたお誘いですか?~肉食ナルシストと絶対恋愛しない女子~

135897.description: "Your body is so sensitive, you just don't know what to do with it, do you?" My boyfriend's on the other side of the phone, but my superior still sticks it all the way in... and my body hungers for even more pleasure! I met this really hot older guy on a trip overseas, even though I'm in a really romantic relationship with my boyfriend back in Japan... I end up having a one-night stand with this guy! And it turns out that he's my superior at work! He forces me to have sex and then makes me cum over and over again! What's going to happen to my love life?!

title.romaji: Ichiya Kagiri no Himegoto Kara Hajimaru Koi

135898.description:
Saetbyeol had a lot on his plate: he's an omega who hates alphas, his mom is constantly causing trouble, and his high school boyfriend is a jerk. Naturally, he ran off and hid himself after graduation to live a new life away from these problems. But one day, he runs into Hyeontae, a friend from his past that he's been running from for so long. It shouldn't be a big problem though, since Hyeontae's a beta who just wants to be a good friend...or is he?

(Source: Lezhin US)

135899.description:
"I feel like showing off to others how cute my wife's panting is."

Hikari is very loved by her husband, Shuuichi. Shuuichi always compliments Hikari, even about the smallest of changes. As a result, Hikari has become accustomed to her husband's endless doting.

One day, while speaking to her friend, Hikari realizes that husbands like Shuuichi are rare, and finds out that she might have been taking him for granted. While it doesn't matter to Shuuichi, Hikari decides to express her gratitude by...?

A story about how a shy wife conveys her gratitude to her beloved husband through sexual favors?!

Do fall in love with this warm, sweet, and loving duo

HIGH SCORE スペシャルFUNブック HIGE SCORE（ヒゲスコア）
title.romaji: HIGH SCORE Special Funbook: HIGE SCORE

135901.description:
The country of the Sun and Light, Vestar Empire, and the country of Fire and Purity, Younghwa Empire, have decided to end a long war between the countries by forming a pact of peace.

Following the requirements of the pact, Leeyeon, as a representative of the Younghwa Empire, leaves for the Vestar Empire. There, he meets Calix...

title.native: ギリシャ神話劇場 神々と人々の日々
title.romaji: Greece Shinwa Gekijou: Kamigami to Hitobito no Hibi

135903.description:
Solyi Jin, a recently turned Omega, was given the job to find proof of a famous actor's scandal. This famous Alpha actor, Kieun Baek, unfortunately caught Solyi Jin and gave him proper punishment.
Kieun Baek grows closer with Solyi Jin, he soon finds out somebody was plotting against him...

(Source: INKR)

135904.description:
“Please…hold me.”
“But, sir…”

Il-Yeon has left home to do a task at his father’s request. He has returned to a place he hasn’t been in ten years. My, how things have changed. And he can’t wait to see some familiar old faces again. But suddenly, one-night Il-Yeon is overwhelmed by a debilitating sickness. No, it can’t be…not here…not now… It’s that sickness that consumes his entire body with a burning fire that can only be treated by…the pleasure given by another. By chance or by fate, Il-Yeon stumbles upon the commoner, Ungae, and asks for his immediate assistance.
Il-Yeon has a duty to carry on the family line as a Yin being but he surrenders to his instincts and spends a dream-like night with Ungae. This is the tale of how Il-Yeon, the noble, and the mysterious Ungae, begin their unforgettable passion together.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)
synonyms: Come Here, I'll Carry You to Play

135905.description: "Omega Bus" is leaving. Birth is the basics, everything is in the process of being attracted to each other's pheromones. At every stop, there will be a world view of delicious restaurants. We will serve you deliciously to where you want to go, so trust me and get on board!

synonyms: You are the daughter of my first love.

135910.description:
When they were little, Kotaro and Kazuho promised that they would live together so that Kota didn't have to go outside to spend time with Kazu. They kept their promise, and now Kazu lives with a hermit who works from home and hates leaving the house. Kazu, worried about Kota's health and future, tries to drag him out of the house by inviting him to go on walks and going shopping, to no avail. After some advice from a coworker, he makes one last effort in making Kota go outside by saying he will do anything Kota wants. So... what does Kota want?

(Source: Futekiya)

title.native: いきつく先はあまい恋人

135911.description:
Ryu, ex-designer now turned cafe worker at Cafe Cleo owned by an old family friend, lives life faking smiles and being agreeable. His act would have been flawless if not for an annoying young customer, Haruto, who seems to see through him. As fate would have it, Ryu finds himself mentoring Haruto for his entrance exams. Little by little, they wade through the lies and acts, understanding each other better.

(Source: Futekiya)

title.english: The Puppy Dog Student Can't Ignore The Two-Faced Waiter
title.native: ワンコ高校生は腹黒店員をほっとけない

135912.description: This work depicts real professional baseball players and baseball teams in a parodical fashion and the main character is modeled after Koichi Tabuchi, who was the catcher and the fourth batter of the Hanshin Tigers at the time of serialization.

135915.description:
"My sister wants to possess my body unlawfully?"

Mo Xin, a highschool student who has split personality fell in love with transfer student Shi Ming. However, the one that Shi Ming like is Mo Yu, the beautiful owner of a flower shop. What Shi Ming does not know is that "Mo Yu" is Mo Xin's second personality...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

135916.description:
A muscular boy who grew up deep in the mountains thought he had finally found love in high school. She's beautiful and popular, too! But the reality wasn't as simple as the muscle-head boy thought...

(Source: Dongman, translated)

135917.description:
Harry the Cannibal, "Psycho Killer" Richard, and the vengeful spirit Yoshie.
They are what we commonly call Killers.

Today, they gather in secret.

For a drinking party!

Just a friendly gathering between friends, the Killers!

(Source: Pixiv, translated)

Nominated for the Tsugi ni Kuru Manga Taisho in 2021

135921.description: Mako Umezu, the little sister of the horror mangaka Kazuo Umezu, opens a strange fan-letter adressed to her brother. Inside the envelope, Mako finds the picture of a girl, two big snake scales and a letter from a girl named Youko Numeta, saying that those snake scales are in fact the scales of her step-sister, Kurumi.

135922.description: Starring a scientist who specializes in scatology and works in a toilet-shaped laboratory.

135927.description: Prequel manga that takes place approximately 120 minutes before Evangelion: 3.0 You Can (Not) Redo. The booklet EVA-EXTRA-EXTRA was distributed to viewers of Evangelion: 3.0+1.01 Thrice Upon a Time as a part of the movie's final run in theaters.

135928.description:
Han-Kyeol, a busybody studying to become a cop, is completely drawn to a part-timer Ji-Hoon at the newly opened dessert shop these days. He only tries to help Ji-Hoon who is the clumsiest on the face of the earth at the beginning. Nevertheless, Han-Kyeol becomes mesmerized by Ji-Hoon’s sweet, gorgeous face hiding behind the glasses and entirely falls for it. Keeping horrible scars on his body, probably from being bullied, Ji-Hoon seems vulnerable to Han-Kyeol. Ji-Hoon always thanks him for his help with a beaming smile that makes Han-Kyeol’s heart race out of control. Hank-Keol tries to convince himself and everyone else that it is only for the sake of humanity, but is that really the case? Fate has made two people from opposite poles run into each other! Let’s fall in love in the “right” relationship!

(Source: Netcomics, edited)
synonyms: All ทั้งหัวใจยกให้นาย

135929.description:
Captain Kyle is a man of the people. He works hard to help merchants secure fair prices and, most importantly, he hates people who value money over mankind. People just like the Roches… So, when the Roche household starts searching for a new servant, Kyle sees an oh-so-appetizing opportunity: the chance to sneak behind enemy lines and prove that the Roches are rotten to the core. But in between inter-family feuding and painfully obvious political plots, Kyle unearths a bigger mystery: the eldest son refuses to eat. Determined to get to the bottom of the Roche family's decay, Kyle takes it upon himself to solve this particular conundrum. However, it soon turns out that food might not be the only appetite that begins to stir…

(Source: Lezhin US)

135930.description:
Haruma Sakuraba's childhood friend Shuuji Inukai was a cut above him in every way imaginable, living out the glamorous life bestowed upon him. Haruma, an unassuming salary man, has lived his every day clutching onto his inferiority complex, existing only in Shuuji's shadow. One day, Haruma coincidentally met Shuuji's wife, Reika Sumi, who Haruma had always secretly admired since his high school days. With feelings of envy, jealousy, and more, a "secret" is born from Haruma's repetitive days.

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

135931.description:
An unaware, beloved mobster is very active in the world of RPGs! With his natural talents, he becomes irresistible to potential heroines! An unpredictable and unexpected fantasy in which a NPC changes the world! The Royal Academy of the Kingdom of Ezelbytes is the largest academy in the kingdom. The Royal Academy of the Ezelbite Kingdom, the largest school in the kingdom, is home to princes, duchesses, sons of powerful men, and other people with prestigious titles. At first glance, Rey appears to be a fast-paced young man who cares little about success or social mobility. But in fact he is the "strongest NPC" with the blessing of a powerful spirit and charisma! He attracts the attention of the prince, the prince's fiancee, saints, and others, and even finds himself in a harem! Rei meets various people, leading to his destiny changing often. unaware that this world itself is an RPG "Real Fantasy". A boy with no desire for success and no self-awareness changes the world! An unpredictable and unexpected fantasy begins!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Nobles and How They Trouble the Heir to the Viscount
title.native: たかが子爵嫡男に高貴な人たちがグイグイきて困る＠COMIC
title.romaji: Takaga Shishaku Chakunan ni Koukina Hitotachi ga Guigui Kite Komaru @COMIC

135933.description:
“I didn’t think senpai would be like this!!!”

By coincidence, the low-class gossamer-winged butterfly Tsubasa catches sight of the son of a distinguished tarantula family, Nagumo Sumiya. Saved by his words, Tsubasa holds admiration for him. From a single glance, he wants to meet him, and he enrolls in Sumiya’s school Seihoku Academy, where only the elite gather. However, hardships due to his low-class awaited him there. On top of that, Sumiyaーhis only hopeーtosses him aside, saying, “I hate gossamer-winged butterflies.” Tsubasa had believed that he would be acknowledged and becomes depressed. At that time, he becomes trapped in the web that Sumiya had laid, where he’s injected with an aphrodisiac venom and is held down…?

An academy caste love story between an arrogant tarantula X a gossamer-winged butterfly with admirable reasons.

Chapter counts include extra chapters.

135934.description:
Oliver, a hairdresser obsessed by shiny things, has undertaken a journey to rescue a princess who possesses hair made of gold. It is said that the princess is far away in a tower that is surrounded by monsters. The journey proves to be challenging for Oliver who has only wielded a pair of scissors all of his life. Within the first few days, he is attacked by a beast. The beast attempts to... kiss him?! What is to happen next?!

(Source: BookCube, translated)

Note: Includes a prologue.
synonyms: I Am the Prince of This Land

135935.description: A girl somehow dies everyday, but has the strange power of being able to revive shortly after. She meets a boy who wants to help her go a day without dying.

135936.description:
The highlight of chef Mei Suzumori’s year is the Tanabata Festival—the one day a year when a pair of mythical lovers reunites. For Mei, it’s the day that a mysterious handsome stranger visits his adopted family’s restaurant to buy tasty seasonal taiyaki. Unable to hold his feelings for the attractive stranger back any longer, Mei professes his love—and finds he’s linked to the enigmatic Naru by a bond much deeper and more complicated than he ever imagined.

(Source: SuBLime)

135937.description:
Adult novelist Baekyeon suffers from sociophobia and hasn't left his old decrepit villa for years. The only one who cares for him is his editor Soohyun. One day, the bugs keep appearing inside his home, and Baekyeon has had enought and calls Soohyun for help. Soohyun calls extermination service “BFX.” The exterminator Hyuk, with a tall and muscular physique, shows up and Baek's cold heart is thawed...!

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

135938.description:
Famous actor "Milan" likes to drive a scandal. Again this time, it's with a new bodyguard named "Lukas" who was assigned to him.
Lucas reveals that he has longed for Milan since he was a child, despite suffering from terrible pranks since his first day at work.
Milan, who unwittingly lifts his guard when he sees the pure, clear eyes of Lucas, seduces Lucas with alcohol...

135941.description: One day, Nanase-kun died. Unsatisfied with what he accomplished in life, he remained in the afterlife to try to improve himself. He got a job ferrying souls on the Sanzu River, but even that wasn't going well, when his old teacher showed up in the afterlife...?

135943.description:
Rindo Kurosawa is a man who loves horror films and aims to become "king of films", the top of the filming world with horror films. One day, he receives a master tape from Robert Skye, a master of the horror film's world whom he deeply admires. However, this is the beginning of a strange fate for Rindo, as Skye's unfinished work "Axeman" appears from the tape...! In order to realize his ambition, Rindo throws himself into a deadly battle with the "Kinema" who lurk behind the scenes of the film industry...

Note: Includes 4 extra chapters.

135944.description:
"I don't want to lose to Miharu Koshigaya.” That is Keiichi's reason for running. Miharu, however, is a national-level track and field athlete. In order to catch up with her, he continues to practice, practice, and practice...

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

Note: Re-published in Jump GIGA 2021 Autumn on October 21, 2021 with a new color page.

title.native: ラブリー・ランナーズ・ハイ

135945.description:
The strong and smart Kudo decided to enroll in a "prep school for delinquents" just because it was close to home. On his first day, he was surrounded by a group of older students with bad attitudes, but he was saved by Daiga Kishimoto, who scared them off with a single head-butt. Daiga is rumored to be the best fighter in the school, with flamboyant blond hair and a lot of piercings, and Kudo is completely smitten by his cuteness and strength.

(Source:Gush Comics, translated)

title.native: やんちゃか！─ヤンキー、罠に嵌まる─

135946.description:
"I'm really not silly!" The new emperor felt it necessary to justify himself! But no one believed it. "I am the Son of Heaven. It should be whatever beauty is available at my fingertips. Yet why I feel a little lonely..." He murmured. That is the reason that he starts his way to hook up beauties all the time... Note: "Beauty" is widely used for praising the appearance of both men and women in ancient China

(Source: Webcomics)

135948.description:
There’s no doubt that Choi Hyun is a dedicated son. There’s nothing he hasn’t tried to get his parents to feel better, who have fallen under a mysterious illness. But even the most renowned doctor in the village can’t seem to help. As a last resort, Hyun climbs the mountains looking desperately for the “guardian tree” that the local shaman told him to seek out. And when he finally comes to find it, he discovers that the tree is home to a mythical being called the Kirin. Kirin, or rather, Tak-myung certainly is powerful enough to bring Hyun’s parents to full discovery, but he wants something in exchange from Hyun… And while Hyun is willing to make a deal, there are some other more darker forces that have their eyes set on the Kirin and his mythical powers…

(Source: Lezhin US)

135953.description:

135959.description:
Promotional Manhwa for the novel.

I now possess the body of Ophelia, the villainess in the story 'The Crown Prince Returns'. And just like the protagonists in the other reincarnated novels, I thought I would fare well. I died by getting guillotined the first time, the second time was getting my limbs torn apart, third was suicide by poison, and by the fourth time, I was struck with arrows atop the throne. And by the fifth restart, even if I tried to stray from the original storyline, I would still be doomed to die. "Concoct a poison for me. Not one that’s painful, but one that’ll kill me slowly." Therefore, this time, with all my heart and soul, I wished to die properly for once. "After I ascend the throne, are you leaving me behind?" "I sincerely hope that her highness survives, no matter what." "Your Highness, I wish to get to know you better." All these people surrounding aren't letting me die off easily!
synonyms: I Want to Die in Peace!
The Princess Wants to Die Comfortably!
The Princess Wants to Rest in Peace!
The Princess Wishes to Die Peacefully!

135964.description:
I've been reincarnated as the extra character who stalked her husband, the male lead, for 10 years and died. Of course, I tried to divorce him before the female lead appeared.

But, I found out that my young husband's household was secretly abusing him. At that moment, I immediately became overwhelmed with the responsibility and sense of duty a modern adult would have.

Aiden had his back turned away from her and suddenly grabbed her arm forcefully. The strength of his hands alone could have ripped her arms off. Erin timidly called his name and spoke.

"I already reminded you yesterday. We're a married couple, so I'm always on your side."

"..."

"So, everything is alright."

She comforted him with these sweet words like it was a spell. And as if he was under her magic, Aiden stopped trembling.
synonyms: I Failed to Divorce My Husband

135966.description: Tsuburaya Namboku's kabuki play written in the late Edo period, “Yotsuya Kaidan” and Akio Ueda's supernatural novel “Ametsuki Monogatari” are adapted into manga form. There are plenty of explanatory text, so you can enjoy reading and understanding these classics.

title.native: まんがで読む 四谷怪談・雨月物語
title.romaji: Manga de Yomu: Yotsuya Kaidan, Ugetsu Monogatari

135968.description:
Promotional Manhwa for the webnovel.

I came into the world of a novel I was reading, and became an unknown extra destined for a miserable life. Teaching manners to a crazy bastard who turns into a tyrant?

Manners, my ass!

Quick thinking was my only means of survival. I tried everything to prevent such a tragic relationship with the tyrant from happening. I kicked, punched and screamed his head off, but I was still beaten in the end. Actually, he’s unexpectedly docile at times and even told me,

“You’re the first person who understands me.”

The male lead’s personality is strange.

135969.description:
They said a loose tongue spells trouble. Guan Cheng said something during the Latin dance class and got Yu Yunfei's attention. That boy, unexpectedly, decided to break into Guan Cheng's life. "Wait! Why do I feel like I've seen this guy somewhere before?" When a straightforward silly bean was stalked by an attractive bad boy, what should he do?

(Source: Webnovel)

Note: Chapter count includes 4 extras chapters

No Puedo Rechazar A Ese Hombre

135970.description:
"So-Baek, So-Baek. Come live with me."
"Yes. I will. I will always be with you."

Smaller and weaker than his brothers, a baby fox with blue eyes and white fur is abandoned by its mother and left alone in the forest. In front of the trembling, terrified fox, a boy named Mu-Heun appears and takes the fox to his house and gives it the name So-Baek, which means small and white. Their friendly and affectionate days end tragically when intruders come and murder the boy and his family while So-Baek was out hunting one day.

In front of the battered corpse, So-Baek sheds tears. It vows.
"I will be a human being and pray for the rest of my life. May the ashes of Mu-Heun reincarnate and come to see me."

Seventy years passed by, and a man with empty eyes appears to the lonely So-Baek. Why does he remind So-Baek of Mu-Heun?

135972.description:
It’s hungry work being Superman! That’s why every day for lunch in Superman vs. Meshi, Superman makes a quick stop over in Japan to try a new chain restaurant. Whether it’s a hearty bowl of curry or conveyor-belt sushi, the Man of Steel loves to indulge in the delectable delicacies the country has to offer. He’ll even share a meal with the other members of the Justice League from time to time in the hopes of showing them an incredible culinary experience.

(Source: DC Comics)

135974.description:
When his mother Harumi died, his father disappeared, and the middle schooler Yu-kun was left without anyone in the world. The only people who would take him in were his mother's three ex-girlfriends, living together in Okinawa. Harumi's last words were, "It wasn't my husband after all…" Who did she want to be by her side in her final moments? Under the open tropical sky, Yu-kun will spend time with the people who knew his mother best, living together in an off-beat family.

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

135975.description:
All over Japan, throughout the land, innumerable pieces of traditional pottery have been popping up. And the ones who have given a unique flair to every piece are known as the Yakimon! In place of his absent father, the university student Endou Clay must take charge of the "Homura Pottery House." There, he comes across four unique people who are collectively known as the Yakimon: Imari, Bizen, Kutani, and Mino. One tiresome piece, a second tiresome piece, the Yakimon seem to be fooling with him. Even so, Clay is committed to reviving the once-glorious art of pottery. Naturally, the road to this is riddled with challenges!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

The winner of the 14th Gold Future Cup rookie manga competition now launches as a full series! Unique art captures the unfolding battle between hunters and werewolves. Who will win this battle to the death, man or beast? This grim fantasy tale with tons of style begins the hunt in Shonen Jump!

135983.description:
Seonjae succeeds in getting into the same college as his lifelong crush, Hoyeon, and the two start living together. However, everything is ruined on day one when Seonjae’s other housemate, Woojin, finds out about Seonjae's crush on Hoyeon…

(Source: Lalatoon)

Note: Includes a side story.

135984.description: Second year high schooler, Hajime Nakamura, on his first day at his new school runs into a gang of delinquents and gets into serious trouble! What saves him from this mess is a cool, strong and handsome Yankee, Tani Reiji. So he asks if he can be his underling, only to be rejected without a second thought. However, he can't give up his desire to get closer, and when he stubbornly follows him, Reiji gives in and offers him an unexpected proposal: "I could be your friend"...! As a result of getting closer and closer to the beautiful and sexy Reiji, Hajime's horny and naughty fantasies go out of control!

title.native: 発情リレーションシップ

135985.description:
Tracy goes on a blind date every Saturday because getting married seems like the only way to solve her problems. But the question is: will it?

(Source: Toomics)

135991.description:
The obedient female schoolmaster Qin Qing was accidentally involved in a fight on the first day of transfer. Qin Qing used a plan to save the besieged senior. She did not expect that the senior was the discolored school bully Wen Yufeng. From now on, Qin Qing's peaceful campus life will never return...

(Source: MangaToon)

135992.description:
Betrayed by her family five years ago, she lost her loved ones and her lover. But a genius baby was left with her. She vowed to revive her life, but didn't expect to meet the fateful man, Huo Tingchen. "We don't know each other!" "You stole my seed and wanna run away?" "Who stole your what?" Alas, her son is just a mini-version of this man, only cuter and smarter.

(Source: MangaToon)

135993.description:
After maxing out the affection level of all the collectible characters in the MMORPG, Shangyang, Liu Yuan transmigrated into this fantasy land. This resulted in the birth of the biggest con in Shangyang's history, and also the coming of the unprecedented "Love Sage."

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Simple, tall, and really perverted... ❤

135996.description:
The helpless woman became a feared mercenary, then she was transported back in time to face her wicked relatives. This time she won't be bullied so easily and she'll finally have her revenge! But as she drove off those "wolves", the change of fate brings along an even more dangerous "tiger"!

(Source: QQ, translated)

135997.description:
Haruka, a futa girl, went on a tropical vacation with her lover Hitomi. It turns out that the Futanari World Cup is being held on the island, and she's forced to participate! To determine the strongest futanari girl on earth, all the most beautiful futa girls have gathered. The powerful Futanari Battle Tournament begins!

(Source: KTC, translated)

135998.description:
Despite her title, Princess Agatha was a sweet and unassuming girl who lived with relatives away from the royal palace. When her father’s sudden death put her on the throne, she was happy to become the Queen Consort instead, letting her husband Halon rule as the King of Zerlasha. Little did she know that Halon would scheme behind her back, allying with the powerful Kingdom of Cavenia, an erstwhile enemy. With her country Zerlasha falling prey to corruption and crime, the time arrives for Agatha to step up as a true queen and leader. Will Queen Agatha take a stand against King Halon to save her country and protect her people?

(Source: WEBTOONS)
